  • Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups

jobDescription:
Overview
The Test Manager - AI is responsible for leading the organisations quality engineering and AI testing strategy, driving the adoption of innovative testing practices, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled quality solutions across the technology landscape. Operating within a complex enterprise environment, the role provides testing leadership across multiple programs, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable, scalable, and secure solutions that align with business objectives.
This role is accountable for shaping and advancing next-generation quality engineering capabilities by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) into the testing lifecycle. The Test Manager - AI will champion the transformation of traditional testing approaches through the implementation of intelligent, predictive, and self-optimising testing frameworks that enhance efficiency, quality, and delivery outcomes.
Leading global testing teams and collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders, the role fosters a culture of quality, innovation, and continuous improvement while driving testing maturity, operational excellence, and the adoption of industry-leading practices across the organisation.

Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities
Strategic Focus
  • Formulate the strategic vision and technical roadmap for integrating AI and Generative AI into the testing lifecycle. Oversee the deployment of intelligent frameworks optimizing automated test case generation, autonomous test execution, and computer-vision visual validations.
  • Manage and accountable for a Portfolio of programs/projects to ensure successful delivery and taking Business on the quality journey.
  • Strong due diligence and analysis skills towards test solution designing.
  • Oversee the modernization of scalable enterprise test automation frameworks embedded seamlessly into high-velocity CI/CD continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Deploy AI/ML analytical tools to evaluate historical defect logs, identifying risk patterns, predicting system regressions, and proactively adjusting test focus areas.
  • Formulate an effective, practical but robust Test Strategy by coordinating with all relevant stakeholders considering a highly complex financial services environment.
  • Assess any quality gaps and keep the stakeholders informed in timely manner and suggest solution to resolve any blockers.
  • Identify areas of improvement and establish a continuous improvement process.
Operational Management
  • Manage the Full E2E testing lifecycle of assigned projects in a multi-vendor and in distributed delivery environment.
  • Evaluate, proof-of-concept, and manage commercial relationships with emerging AI testing vendors, maximizing ROI across tools, frameworks, and resource allocations.
  • Review program/project level business requirements, technical specifications, end to end Business Processes and solution design documents, highlighting any gaps or potential improvements.
  • Define and deploy defect preventive process and measures in distributed delivery model.
  • Defect Management activities (prioritization, including, conducting defect triage meeting with business, technology & interface partners); work with relevant stakeholders to agree on workaround for outstanding defects and defects resolutions.
  • Participate in the planning of UAT, PVT for Programs and Projects (including approach and scope of PVT).
  • Facilitates the development, implementation, and adherence of testing department standards in partnership with other test team leaders.
  • Establish key performance indicators and quality metrics to measure and report on the effectiveness of the testing process.
  • Communicate quality metrics to relevant stakeholders.
  • Review reports produced by the testing teams, provide guidance, evolve process, and actively participate in resolving issues/roadblocks to testing progress.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
  • Mentor the testing team and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.
People Leadership
  • Support the project team in leveraging testing tools to improve team productivity and effectiveness (Test Management, Defect Management, and Test Automation, Performance Testing, AI Driven Testing).
  • Work within a team contributing to:
  • Timely delivery of assigned tasks and project outcomes.
  • Effective use of technology to solve business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
  • Innovation and continuous improvement through the development of practical and scalable solutions.
  • Motivate the team to consistently deliver quality results through collaboration, accountability, and innovation.
Governance & Risk
  • Review and sign-off of testing artefacts (Test Plans and Test Summary Reports), liaising with respective project team members (including Development teams, Test teams, Business, Solution Designers, Architects, IT, PMs, and other stakeholders.)
  • Governance and management of vendor achievement against Service Level Agreements, measuring performance against established metrics and evaluating third-party operations for quality and adherence to agreed schedule and budget requirements to align delivered Services with business IT needs and key stakeholder expectations.
  • Manage and document the quality assurance activities with internal reporting and audits.
  • Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
  • Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
  • Ensure maintenance of appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
  • Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

Experience & Personal Attributes
Experience
  • Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline
  • 14+ years of authentic experience in Software Testing, Quality Assurance, and Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in direct managerial or organizational leadership capacities, directly managing distributed engineering teams in complex E2E integrated financial platform.
  • Practical experience utilizing Generative AI models (e.g., OpenAI API, GitHub Copilot) for building intelligent synthetic data, structural test scaffolding, and automating framework maintenance.
  • Knowledge or functional experience in testing and handling validation patterns specific to AI/ML software ecosystems.
  • Extensive experience in managing a multi-vendor engagement.
  • Extensive experience in building process, practices, and test team in distributed delivery model
  • Strong E2E test management background within a fast-paced business and in complex IT application landscape.
  • Strong commercial / business acumen
  • Experience in CI/CD pipeline and tools such as Azure Devops
  • Accounting / Superannuation / Insurance / BFSI highly desirable.
  • Core automation experience in Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
  • Experience in API testing, Mobile, App testing highly desirable.
  • Certification in Domain/Testing/Delivery methodology like ISTQB, Agile, ASFA highly desirable
  • Working experience working in an Agile scrum environment, expert in JIRA and Confluence or similar tools
  • Hands on experience in improving Testing & QA capabilities with a strong awareness of industry developments and best practice.
  • Managing the mobilization and operation of Testing services.
  • A strong background in financial services & pensions industry will be highly advantageous.
Personal Attributes
  • Demonstrate strong thought leadership, strategic thinking, and effective communication in driving and uplifting Quality through all stages of the SDLC - and within the Test practice.
  • Strong influential skills with an emphasis on building quality output, and continuous improvement
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, needed to communicate with global teams/stakeholders.
  • Practical and simple problem-solving approach.
  • Capable of managing high pressure and short timelines, with the willingness to be flexible
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and prioritize them

ROLE PURPOSE
Serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native Java solutions while raising engineering standards through deep technical expertise, hands-on problem solving, and architecture influence.
DESIGNATION - Principal Software Engineer

EXPERIENCE - 12+ years

LOCATION - Hyderabad, India

FUNCTION
Software Engineering DOMAIN Enterprise / Healthcare WORK MODEL As applicable

We are seeking an accomplished Principal Software Engineer to operate as a senior individual contributor focused on technical strategy, solution architecture, hands-on engineering, and modernization of enterprise platforms. This role is not a people-management position; it is designed for a deeply technical leader who can influence architecture, guide engineering direction, solve complex technical problems, and deliver high-quality solutions through expertise and credibility.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience across Java, Spring, Azure, DevOps, Kafka, Spark, APIs, relational databases, distributed systems, resiliency, security, and performance engineering. This individual will partner with architects, product owners, engineering teams, QA, and production support to translate complex requirements into scalable designs, reference implementations, technical patterns, and production-ready software.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Architecture and Technical Design
    • Own and influence architecture for complex enterprise applications, services, APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native components
    • Translate business and platform requirements into scalable solution designs, architecture decisions, technical specifications, and implementation-ready engineering guidance
    • Define and promote reusable technical patterns, reference implementations, design guardrails, and engineering standards across teams
    • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, resilience, performance, observability, maintainability, and operational support expectations
  • Hands-on Engineering and Technical Execution
    • Design, build, test, debug, optimize, and document complex enterprise applications, microservices, APIs, Spark jobs, and integration components
    • Provide hands-on expertise in Java, Spring, Azure, DevOps, Kafka, distributed systems, data processing, and application architecture patterns
    • Solve complex technical problems independently, including performance bottlenecks, scalability constraints, deployment issues, defect root causes, and production-readiness gaps
    • Build reliable Kafka producer and consumer integrations, support event-driven architecture patterns, and guide teams on operationally safe implementation practices
    • Deliver high-quality engineering outcomes without direct people-management responsibility, using technical influence, mentoring, and design authority to raise team capability
  • AI-Enabled Engineering and Modernization
    • Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate design analysis, coding, unit testing, documentation, defect analysis, modernization, and engineering productivity
    • Use tools such as Codex, Claude, and comparable AI engineering assistants responsibly, with strong validation of generated code, test cases, designs, and documentation
    • Identify high-value modernization opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort, improve engineering quality, and accelerate transformation of legacy applications and data-processing workloads
    • Promote secure, compliant, and measurable use of AI tools while ensuring outputs meet enterprise engineering standards
  • Testing, Quality, and Release Readiness
    • Prepare test plans, define test data requirements, establish test environments, and execute testing activities based on project needs
    • Participate in design reviews, test case reviews, and Production Support readiness reviews for new releases
    • Support QA, UAT, release, and post-release phases through defect analysis, root cause identification, change maintenance, and issue resolution
    • Promote test automation and ensure adherence to coding standards, documentation standards, quality controls, and delivery governance
    • Confirm that solutions meet functional, technical, performance, supportability, and timeline requirements before release
  • Technical Influence and Cross-Team Collaboration
    • Partner with architects, product owners, SMEs, development teams, QA, DevOps, and production support to align technical decisions with business outcomes and platform strategy
    • Lead architecture and design reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and help teams make informed trade-off decisions
    • Create and maintain architecture decisions, technical design documents, integration specifications, operational runbooks, test evidence, and release-support artifacts
    • Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including risks, options, dependencies, and recommendations
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so
Required Qualifications:
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including deep hands-on experience building and architecting large-scale enterprise applications
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka streams, event-driven architecture, and reliable producer and consumer implementations
  • Experience defining architecture, technical designs, integration patterns, resiliency approaches, performance strategies, and production-readiness standards
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, debugging, documenting, and optimizing complex Spark jobs or large-scale data-processing workloads
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, or comparable relational database platforms, including SQL development, data modeling awareness, and performance considerations
  • Solid expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, Azure Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices
  • Proven ability to operate independently as a senior individual contributor while influencing technical direction across teams
  • Proven solid communication skills with the ability to explain architecture decisions, engineering risks, and solution trade-offs clearly
  • AI and Modern Engineering Capabilities
    • Knowledge of AI Builder and AI-enabled development workflows
    • Proficiency with Codex, Claude, or comparable AI-assisted engineering tools
    • Ability to coach developers on safe, effective, and outcome-oriented use of AI tools and credits
    • Ability to validate AI-generated code and documentation for security, correctness, maintainability, compliance, and alignment with engineering standards

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in Pharmacy Benefit Management, healthcare, insurance, or other highly regulated enterprise domains
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery models across geographically distributed teams
  • Exposure to production-critical batch processing, high-volume data pipelines, and enterprise integration platforms
  • Knowledge of AS/400 or IBM i platforms and legacy application modernization

Individual Contributor Competencies
  • Architecture ownership
    • Owns complex design decisions and connects technical direction to platform outcomes
  • Technical influence
    • Builds alignment through expertise, design clarity, mentoring, and trusted engineering judgment
  • Engineering excellence
    • Raises quality, security, resilience, observability, automation, and maintainability standards
  • Deep technical problem solving
    • Resolves complex engineering issues through analysis, experimentation, and pragmatic execution
  • Ownership and accountability
    • Operates independently, drives outcomes, and proactively identifies risks and dependencies
  • Modern engineering mindset
    • Applies AI, automation, cloud, and modernization practices to improve delivery outcomes

Measures of Success
  • Architecture and design decisions improve scalability, resilience, security, performance, maintainability, and operational supportability
  • Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong root-cause analysis, practical execution, and minimal production impact
  • Reference implementations, engineering standards, and technical patterns improve consistency and delivery quality across teams
  • AI-assisted engineering and automation produce measurable improvements in productivity, quality, documentation, and modernization velocity
  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into architecture decisions, technical risks, dependencies, and recommended solution paths

AI Orchestration: High Level Understanding of LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI - agentic workflow design, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, human-in-the-loop workflows
Observability: Metrics, logging, and distributed tracing at scale - SLO engineering, alerting design, and incident response tooling

LLM AI Tooling: High Level understanding of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini - prompt engineering, RAG architecture, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB), LLMOps
Incident Management: Production incident ownership, structured RCA, and reliability engineering practices in high-availability FSI environments
Cost Engineering: FinOps practices - reserved instance/committed use optimisation, tagging strategy, and cost allocation across AWS and GCP estates

- Experience with service mesh (Istio or Linkerd) for microservices networking and observability
- Familiarity with data platform engineering - Kafka, Spark, or cloud-native analytics services on AWS or GCP

Job Description Test Automation
Designation - Senior Test Analyst (5-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 -12+ years)
Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.
You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.
You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.
You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.
Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.
You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a can do mindset.
Key Responsibilities
  • Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
  • Promote shift-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
  • Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
  • Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
  • Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
  • Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents.
    Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
  • Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
  • Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work.
  • Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
  • Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
  • Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.
Required technical skills and experience
  • Experience with C# / Java Script/ Type Script
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
  • Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
  • Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment
Required soft skills and experience
  • Clear and concise communicator
  • Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
  • Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers business owners.
Desirable skills and experience
  • Experience using Azure DevOps
  • Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
  • Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud-based tools
  • Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc
  • Usage of latest AI tools.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing User Interfaces and databases
  • Youll have ISTQB/ISEB Foundation certifications or equivalent certifications or be working towards achieving them.
  • Experience coordinating with external/Offshore QA resources


Qualifications
Graduate


Additional Information
Good Communication Skills required.

Summary: We are seeking a visionary Physics-Based Simulation Architect to lead the design and deployment of advanced engineering simulation solutions across manufacturing and industrial domains. This role demands deep expertise in Multiphysics simulation, first-principles modeling, and digital twin development, combined with strategic leadership in system-level architectures. You will leverage cutting-edge platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse, cloud simulation environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and MBSE methodologies to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. Join us to drive innovation, enable next-generation simulation architectures, and solve complex engineering challenges for global clients.

Roles & Responsibilities: Architect simulation methods and solutions across Multiphysics domains (mechanical, thermal, fluid, electrical) while orchestrating cross-domain workflows. Design and implement pipelines leveraging NVIDIA platform-based simulation tools such as Omniverse, PhysX, Modulus, and Isaac Sim, integrating physics-based rendering, digital twins, and real-time visualization in cloud or hybrid environments. Leverage cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to automate, scale, and orchestrate simulation workloads. Apply MBSE methodologies (SysML, Cameo, Capella) to formally align system requirements with model execution. Implement cross-domain and hybrid simulations by combining discrete-event modeling for factory workflows with physics-based models for engineering processes such as material, fluid, and thermal. Champion co-simulation architectures, fast-running simulation models, and tool integration across commercial software (ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus) and scripting environments (Python, MATLAB, Modelica). Lead validation and verification efforts by correlating simulation outcomes with experimental datasets and real-world performance. Provide technical leadership and mentorship, guiding development teams and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Actively lead and participate in sales pursuits and pre-sales engagements, including discussions and presentations of capabilities and solutions to potential clients and internal stakeholders. Contribute to industry thought leadership through patents, whitepapers, POVs, proof of concepts, conference and academic presentations, and capability showcases. Work with global clients and cross-functional teams in a multicultural and distributed environment. Professional & Technical SkillsMust-Have Skills: Deep expertise in physics-based modeling and simulation across multiple engineering domains, with a strong foundation in numerical methods, PDE solvers, continuum mechanics, reduced-order modeling, and real-time co-simulation. Extensive hands-on experience with commercial simulation tools such as ANSYS, COMSOL, MOOSE, LAMMPS, OpenFOAM, and similar platforms. Proven ability in creating digital twins and developing high-fidelity physics-based visualizations to support real-time simulation and decision-making for industrial applications. Experience in generating synthetic data to validate and test real-time industrial simulation applications. Strong background in cloud-based simulation workflows, including automation, orchestration, and deployment of scalable simulation pipelines on platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Solid understanding of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), with experience in aligning system requirements, architecture models, and simulation execution using tools like SysML, Cameo, or Capella. Comprehensive knowledge of Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and hybrid modeling approaches to simulate discrete manufacturing processes alongside continuous physics-based models. Significant industry experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, automotive, or aerospace sectors.Good-to-Have Skills: Proficiency in scripting and automation using languages such as Python, C++, and MATLAB for simulation workflows. Experience in digital twin development for applications like factory planning, robotics simulation, and predictive maintenance. Working knowledge of NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim for advanced simulation and visualization. Familiarity with FMI/FMU standards, OpenModelica, OpenUSD, and robotics simulation frameworks. Exposure to AI/ML-driven simulation workflows, including Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), surrogate modeling, and generative AI tools for model creation and behavior prediction.Additional Info: Cand should have 12 to16+ years of experience Bachelor s or Master s in Engineering, Physics, or Ph.D. in related field. This position is based at Bengaluru/Pune location.

Qualification 15 years full time education

  • Create architecture artifacts: solution blueprints, reference architectures, integration diagrams, and technical roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams on cloud-native deployments (AWS or Azure) and DevSecOps strategies.
  • Mentor technical teams and support architectural governance across project delivery.

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in designing developing technology solutions on an enterprise-scale for Life Science RD space;
  • Strong knowledge of clinical systems landscape (e.g., EDC, CTMS, eTMF, eCOA, CDMS, SDTM, ADaM, SAS).
  • Expertise in cloud architecture using AWS and/or Azure including serverless, containers, API management, and security best practices.

  • Demonstrated expertise in building scalable data pipelines, real-time streaming architectures, and enterprise-grade data lakes and warehouses.

CI/CD Modernization

  • Identify and implement high-impact AI use cases that improve engineering productivity.

Agent-Ready Repositories

  • Define repository standards, including metadata, documentation, instructions, templates, and governance controls.
  • Ensure repositories are structured to support AI-powered tools while maintaining security and compliance.
  • Establish best practices for repository organization and developer experience.

AI Agent Workflows & Governance

  • Integrate AI capabilities across GitHub, CI/CD platforms, Jira, and related engineering ecosystems.
  • Define guardrails for access control, security reviews, code validation, approvals, and compliance.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop validation mechanisms to ensure safe and reliable AI adoption.

Platform Enablement & Adoption

  • Drive adoption of standardized DevOps and AI engineering practices across teams.
  • Develop reusable starter kits, golden paths, documentation, and onboarding frameworks.
  • Gather feedback from engineering teams and continuously improve platform capabilities and developer experience.

Required Experience & Skills

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
  • Proven expertise in designing reusable workflows, developer platforms, and automation frameworks.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Bash, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application delivery.
  • Deep understanding of GitHub ecosystem components, including Pull Requests, CODEOWNERS, branch protection rules, and repository governance.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide CI/CD transformation initiatives.

AI & Agentic Engineering

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar platforms.
  • Practical experience applying AI to software engineering activities including code analysis, testing, migration, and documentation.
  • Expertise in managing repository-level AI context, prompts, instructions, and knowledge assets.
  • Strong understanding of AI risks, including hallucinations, security vulnerabilities, data leakage, and over-automation.
  • Experience implementing human-in-the-loop validation processes and responsible AI practices.

Cloud & Automation

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and security automation.

Leadership Expectations

  • End-to-End Ownership: Drive platform modernization initiatives from strategy through execution.
  • Execution Focus: Deliver practical tooling, automation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Innovation Mindset: Translate emerging AI capabilities into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Strategic Thinking: Balance enterprise standardization with project-specific needs.
  • Influential Leadership: Lead by example, mentor teams, and drive adoption through tangible results.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of automation, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading large-scale DevOps transformation programs.
  • Exposure to AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) frameworks.
  • Experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) and developer self-service capabilities.
  • Relevant certifications in Cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, or AI technologies are preferred.

Job Summary
Senior Accountant
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional with a passion for international insurance and reinsurance? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where precision meets big-picture thinking? If you're ready to play a pivotal role in ensuring compliant and efficient risk transfers and cash flows across a global network, this opportunity is for you!
About the Role
As a Senior Accountant within the International Financial Management (IFM) team, you will be at the heart of technically accounting for international programme policy transactions. You will ensure seamless and compliant risk transfers and cash flows between Producing/Local Offices, Network Partners, the Central Pooling Carrier, and External (Co-)Reinsurers. This is a high-impact role that combines technical accounting expertise with cross-functional collaboration and project leadership on a truly global scale.
Key Responsibilities
  • Book, reconcile and settle technical accounts (premium, commissions, fees, claims payments) to and from the pooling carrier for assumed reinsurance NP policies, skeleton technical bookings and reinsurance transactions on a monthly basis
  • Produce monthly co-reinsurance and Network Partner statements of account with accuracy and timeliness
  • Resolve reconciliation findings (Co-reinsurance/NP) in collaboration with respective internal and external functions
  • Monitor and report open balances and coordinate with the International Desk, Network Partner Coordinator, regional Technical Accounting teams, and Underwriters on outstanding balances
  • Act as the first point of contact within International Business for Local/Producing Office Technical Accounting teams, Finance FPA, and Products performing financial reporting on International Business
  • Ensure reconciliation of International Business technical accounts in the administration system and support Finance on reconciliations in financial ledgers as required (e.g. skeleton process, local premium collection, central premium collection, invoiced versus booked)
  • Compare, contrast and authorize incoming co-reinsurance data in the system against real contracts
  • Define, implement and execute processes relating to technical accounting and credit control for international programmes
  • Maintain control over risk assessment processes
  • Liaise with International Desk, Global Network Management, Regional Technical Accounting teams, Claims/Claims Operations and Underwriters/Underwriting Assistance teams to ensure service standards are met
  • Lead ongoing projects to strengthen the IFM core process
  • Actively support audits by responding to RFIs and IRFs
  • Participate in meetings and training sessions for the purpose of conveying information required to perform job functions
  • Contribute to team effort by assisting other team members when necessary
  • Perform other duties as assigned
About the Team
The International Financial Management (IFM) team's mandate is to technically account for international programme policy transactions, ensuring compliant and efficient risk transfers and cash flows between Producing/Local Offices, Network Partners, the Central Pooling Carrier, and External (Co-)Reinsurers. The team is also responsible for reporting, analytics, and commentaries regarding International Business, including monthly aged debt reports, monthly premium flows by Producing Office, and consolidation of accounts by client programme.
The IFM team's key customers include:
  • Corporate Solutions and Network Partner Local Offices worldwide
  • Corporate Solutions Producing Offices
  • External brokers and insureds
  • Finance Corporate Solutions
  • Reinsurance partners
About You
You are a seasoned accounting professional who brings both technical depth and collaborative energy to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, communicating intricate financial matters to diverse audiences, and taking ownership of your responsibilities with confidence and integrity. You are a natural relationship-builder who earns trust across teams and geographies, and you are driven by a commitment to continuous improvement.
We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements
  • CA/CS/ICWA/MBA (Finance) with at least 810 years of relevant working experience and good knowledge of insurance/reinsurance
  • Previous Insurance Technical Accounting experience understanding of insurance technical accounting principles as well as solid understanding of international insurance programmes
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to deliver quality output to short deadlines and manage details without losing sight of the big picture
These Are Additional Nice to Haves
  • Previous experience in assumed reinsurance technical accounting and reconciliation of pooling carrier transactions
  • Strong communication skills , in particular the ability to summarize complex technical issues for a non-expert audience, both written and verbal
  • Capability of building trust with all areas of the business, in particular with Primary Lead teams, Consolidation and regional Technical Accounting teams, and regional Operations teams
  • Ability to translate business initiatives into clear, actionable strategies
  • Good project management skills with a commitment to continuous process improvement
  • Stress resilience with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
  • Excellent command of English (spoken and written)
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to work well and build trust with others
  • Personal accountability for areas of responsibility

Programme Overview

Lead poisoning is one of Indias most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the worlds highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 g/dL; the national average is 6.2 g/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.

National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for Indias lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCFs track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCFs embedded TSU and lead embedded teams at national and state levels. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.

The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the Associate Director and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Dynatrace Observability Engineer / Administrator to lead the implementation, administration, and continuous enhancement of the Dynatrace SaaS observability platform. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in end-to-end monitoring, event management, ServiceNow integration, dashboard engineering, and automation.

This role will work closely with Infrastructure, Application, Network, Security, Cloud, and Service Management teams to deliver a unified observability framework, improve operational visibility, accelerate incident resolution, and drive proactive monitoring across enterprise services.

Key Responsibilities

Dynatrace Platform Administration & Architecture

  • Administer and manage the Dynatrace SaaS platform, including OneAgent, ActiveGate, extensions, integrations, and tenant configurations.

  • Design and maintain scalable observability architecture supporting infrastructure, applications, databases, middleware, network, and cloud environments.

  • Configure monitoring policies, management zones, tagging strategies, alerting profiles, and role-based access controls.

  • Lead platform upgrades, configuration optimization, and adoption of new Dynatrace capabilities.

Monitoring & Observability Engineering

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide observability solutions covering metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, and real-user monitoring (RUM).

  • Configure infrastructure, application, database, middleware, network, and Kubernetes monitoring.

  • Create custom monitoring extensions and automation workflows using Dynatrace APIs.

  • Develop AI-driven monitoring use cases utilizing Dynatrace Davis AI for anomaly detection and root cause analysis.

ServiceNow Integration & Event Management

  • Design, implement, and support integration between Dynatrace and ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management platforms.

  • Configure automated incident creation, event correlation, deduplication, and alert enrichment.

  • Implement bidirectional synchronization between Dynatrace events and ServiceNow incidents.

  • Integrate monitoring events with CMDB, Service Mapping, and Event Management workflows.

  • Develop event handling standards, escalation workflows, suppression policies, and alert tuning strategies to reduce noise and improve operational efficiency.

Dashboard & Reporting Engineering

  • Design and develop executive, operational, and technical dashboards using Dynatrace Dashboards

  • Create business service health dashboards, application performance dashboards, SLA reporting dashboards, and infrastructure monitoring views.

  • Develop advanced visualizations for:

    • Service availability

    • Application performance trends

    • Capacity analytics

    • Event correlation

    • Incident management KPIs

    • Observability maturity reporting

  • Provide meaningful insights and recommendations through data visualization and reporting.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop automation scripts using Python, Shell, Perl, or PowerShell.

  • Automate monitoring onboarding, dashboard creation, alert configuration, and reporting activities.

  • Integrate Dynatrace with enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, Splunk, CyberArk, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services.

  • Utilize REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code practices for monitoring automation.

Operational Support & Governance

  • Monitor platform performance, capacity, availability, and data ingestion health.

  • Troubleshoot monitoring gaps, agent issues, integration failures, and dashboard performance concerns.

  • Define monitoring standards, governance policies, and operational best practices.

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, SOPs, technical runbooks, and knowledge articles.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements by maintaining monitoring evidence and reporting controls.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Overall 8+ years of IT experience.

  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Dynatrace administration and observability engineering.

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience integrating monitoring platforms with ServiceNow ITSM/Event Management.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale monitoring environments across infrastructure and application landscapes.

  • Experience in SaaS-based observability platforms and cloud monitoring solutions.

  • Strong experience working with Linux/RHEL environments.

  • Demonstrates advanced troubleshooting skills, analytical approach, and expertise in root-cause analysis within complex distributed environments.

  • Experience operating within regulated industries, preferably banking or financial services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dynatrace Associate, Professional, or Certified Administrator certification.

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

  • Experience with Observability, AIOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.

  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, and Hybrid Cloud monitoring.

  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

jobDescription:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you''ll have the opportunity to create impact at scale tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Job Summary
Senior Software Engineers at Visa are responsible for conducting, planning, and overseeing multiple aspects of the analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of computer programs for commercial or end user applications. The role includes writing code, completing programming tasks, and performing testing and debugging of applications. Documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance are completed as part of the role. Senior Software Engineers may interface with users to define system requirements and necessary modifications or to develop cost estimates, budgets, and schedules.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop solutions using Java EE technologies, Spring, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and Web Services (REST/RPC).
  • Participate in technical design in collaboration with developers, architects, and UX designers.
  • Peer review code and follow coding style standards and guidelines.
  • Use Test Driven Development techniques and write unit and integration automation tests.
  • Write documentation and share knowledge with other team members.
  • Practice agile scrum methodology and contribute to improving team Agile processes.
  • Engage in technical analysis with product team requirements and execute Terraform to create/remove resources on AWS.
  • Monitor applications through logs/metrics and perform code reviews.
  • Develop high quality and robust software components that delight customers.
  • Complete proof of concepts and other technical evaluations of technologies, designs, and solutions.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:
  • 8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelors Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Experience in Java EE technologies, Open-Source frameworks including Spring, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and Web Services (REST/RPC).
  • Experience on microservices, containerization, and ability to quickly build and drive team to support future systems.
  • Experience evaluating business requirements and translating them into technical design documents.
  • Experience in Design Patterns and data modelling.
  • Experience in Kafka and other No-SQL databases.
  • Solid understanding and experience working with Database systems like MySQL and MSSQL.
  • Experience working on application servers like Apache Tomcat, OS platforms like UNIX, Windows, and Linux.
  • Experience with build automation tools including Maven/Gradle/Jenkins/Grunt.
  • Exposure and good knowledge on web application security.
  • Experience in version control tools: BitBucket, Git or similar.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
  • Significant experience with accessibility standards and regulations such as WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines), assistive technologies, and semantic HTML.
  • Significant experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, guided by industry best practices and latest techniques.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript UI frameworks such as React and AngularJS.
  • Experience with design and accessibility patterns.
  • Experience with design system library (UI components, style guidelines and design principles).
  • Experience with source control (e.g., Git) and continuous integration (e.g., TeamCity).
  • Experience programming in Java, J2EE.
  • Solid understanding of database technologies and SQL and JPA.
  • Preferred experience in payments integration and/or online ecommerce shopping and/or Payment gateways.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobDescription:

Project Role Description : Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.


Must have skills : Large Language Models (LLMs)


Good to have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform
Minimum
18 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Summary / Description

AI Powered Tech Talent

  • Lead / Senior Architect in AI LLM Technology Architecture, serving as the definitive technical authority for end-to-end AI architecture on Databricks.
  • Own the complete AI platform architecture spanning classical machine learning, generative AI, LLM applications, RAG, agentic systems, context engineering, model platforms, inference and enterprise AI integration.
  • Operate at executive and senior stakeholder level, connecting business goals, industry priorities and transformation agendas to a coherent technical vision and sequenced AI implementation roadmap.
  • Bring practical industry experience in financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, telecom or life sciences to ensure AI architectures address domain realities, regulatory expectations, security constraints, operational processes and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead and integrate work across multiple domain architects and subject matter specialists, resolving cross-domain design decisions and ensuring the full AI solution is cohesive, technically sound and enterprise-ready.
  • Partner with CIOs, CTOs, business leaders and delivery stakeholders to shape enterprise AI strategy and convert business priorities into phased technical roadmaps.
  • Lead enterprise AI architecture assessments, target-state definition, gap analysis, platform selection, modernization opportunities and implementation sequencing.
  • For Databricks, set the enterprise direction for lakehouse-native AI platforms define governed RAG and multi-agent architectures using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Vector Search and Mosaic AI establish model serving, evaluation, tracing and monitoring patterns through MLflow and Databricks workflows guide architecture decisions for data governance, scalability and cost control.
  • Own the end-to-end technical solution for complex AI platforms, ensuring all domains are aligned to business objectives, enterprise standards and non-functional requirements.
  • Define architectural direction for model- and tool-agnostic multi-agent systems including orchestration, memory, tool/skill use, agent registry, AI gateway/control-plane patterns and service abstraction.
  • Establish the enterprise context layer architecture spanning knowledge graphs, ontologies, vector search, semantic retrieval, prompt/context assembly and conversation state management.
  • Set security, governance, observability, performance, scalability and reliability standards across AI solution domains, including identity, authorization, PII protection, layered guardrails, auditability and evaluation gates.
  • Mandate productized evaluation and observability practices covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, latency, model quality, cost, safety, reliability and production support metrics.
  • Drive architecture decisions for high-throughput, low-latency inference, model routing, model adaptation/fine-tuning, caching, cost controls and production-ready deployment platforms.
  • Produce and own authoritative architecture artifacts including blueprints, ADRs, sequence diagrams, design specifications, integration patterns, reusable reference architectures and governance playbooks.

    Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor''s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 12+ years of overall experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture or enterprise technology architecture.
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience designing and deploying enterprise-grade advanced AI, data, analytics or cloud-native solutions using at least one cloud vendor.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in LLM and generative AI solution architecture, including agentic AI, RAG, prompt engineering, model integration and evaluation patterns.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience architecting and operationalizing LLM-driven application architecture patterns in production or enterprise-scale environments.
  • Minimum 6+ years of experience in engineering, machine learning, deep learning, NLP solutions, data engineering or large-scale analytical engineering applications.
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior architect in industry domains such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, telecom or life sciences, with ability to align technology choices to business, risk and compliance expectations.

    Required Skills/ Experience
  • Deep architecture and hands-on engineering experience with Databricks Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Agent Framework, MLflow tracing/evaluation, Vector Search, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Lakehouse Monitoring, Feature Store, Databricks Workflows, Jobs and Model Training.
  • Strong ability to shape enterprise-grade AI architecture covering RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, model routing and GenAI evaluation.
  • Experience defining NFRs and architecture controls for performance, scalability, security, privacy, governance, observability, resiliency, cost optimization and operational readiness.
  • Ability to compare platforms, frameworks, foundation models and deployment patterns, making evidence-based technology recommendations and defensible architecture trade-offs.
  • Experience establishing AI gateway/control-plane patterns, agent registry and certification gates, authorization models, layered guardrails, model risk controls and production governance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and thought leadership skills with ability to communicate architecture decisions to executives, product leaders, security teams and engineering delivery teams.

    Good to Have Skills
  • Databricks Machine Learning Professional, Data Engineer Professional or Generative AI certification exposure to Spark/PySpark, Unity Catalog governance, Delta Live Tables, MLflow, LangGraph/LangChain, model fine-tuning and lakehouse performance optimization.
  • Exposure to open-source AI and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with responsible AI, model risk management, AI governance boards, red-teaming, synthetic data, human-in-the-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI FinOps.
  • Recognized thought leadership through reusable architecture assets, platform accelerators, whitepapers, client advisory, internal capability building or conference/community participation.



    Qualification 15 years full time education

A defining mandate of this role is Right Model, Right Task - routing every agentic and LLM workload to the model best suited to it on cost, latency, and accuracy grounds, integrated directly with Lilly's internal data platform so routing and reasoning are grounded in enterprise-native lineage and knowledge graphs rather than bespoke, disconnected metadata. Agentic and AI-assisted ways of working are the expected default across every design, analysis, and documentation activity - and this leader is the reference point for how the broader India team scales AI-native architecture.

Path/Level: R5 (Senior Data Architect)

Key Responsibilities

AI & Agentic Solution Architecture (Hands-On)

  • Architect and personally build multi-agent and LLM-orchestrated solutions - planning/tool-calling agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent-to-agent workflows - for Clinical and Non-Clinical use cases.
  • Design for scale from the start: agent orchestration, state management, concurrency, cost/latency budgets, and failure/retry handling across high-volume production workloads.
  • Implement evaluation, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop patterns so agentic systems are safe, auditable, and production-ready in a regulated environment.

Right Model, Right Task - Platform-Integrated Routing, Lineage & Knowledge Graphs

  • Design and implement a right-model-right-task routing layer that selects the optimal model - by size, provider, and fine-tuned vs. general-purpose - for each agentic task based on complexity, cost, latency, and accuracy requirements, rather than defaulting to one model for every job.
  • Integrate directly with Lilly's internal data platform (Data Hub catalog, lineage, and metadata services) rather than building parallel metadata stores, so routing and agent reasoning are grounded in the enterprises single source of truth.
  • Build and maintain lineage-aware enterprise knowledge graphs sourced from the internal data platform, capturing data provenance, sensitivity, and domain context that ground both agentic reasoning and model-selection decisions.
  • Use lineage and knowledge-graph context to enforce routing policy - for example, regulatory-sensitive Clinical data routes only to approved/validated models, while low-sensitivity exploratory tasks use lighter-weight, lower-cost models.
  • Continuously benchmark and re-tune the model portfolio and routing rules as new models become available, avoiding both over-provisioning expensive frontier models and under-serving tasks that genuinely need them.

AI-Native Data Engineering & Semantic Modeling

  • Use AI-assisted and agentic tooling by default across the data lifecycle - pipeline generation, schema/ontology alignment, data-quality scoring, and documentation - not as an occasional accelerator.
  • Design conceptual, logical, physical, and semantic models - ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs - that ground both self-service analytics and agentic reasoning, built on and reconciled with the platforms native lineage.
  • Build analytics-ready dimensional models and semantic/vector layers that power self-service BI and AI-driven consumption for scientists, statisticians, and business analysts.

Automation & Team Reusability at Scale

  • Build reusable agentic accelerators - agent templates, orchestration patterns, evaluation harnesses, model-routing configs - that the broader India team adopts directly to scale AI-native delivery.
  • Automate lineage capture, schema-drift detection, and data/agent quality checks so the team spends more time on judgment calls, less on manual upkeep.

Overview

Synapt Context Substrate is the trusted context layer that sits between enterprise data and AI agents organizing knowledge, procedures, relationships and decisions so that every agent reasons from the same governed, current source of truth. We are looking for a Technical Lead to join the Customer Success (FDE) team and own the technical arc of customer engagements end to end: from spotting a genuine substrate problem inside a customer''s environment, through building the demo that proves it, to running the pilot and carrying it into production.
This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical leadership role. You will not hand off between the person who sells it and the person who builds it you are both, across every account you own. You will work directly inside the team''s three-stage engagement model Introduce, Prove, Establish and be the technical backbone that moves an account from first conversation to a production deployment the customer treats as standard infrastructure, not a project.

Responsibilities

  1. Use-Case Design (Introduce stage)
  • Read a customer''s estate systems, workflows, existing tools rather than waiting for a fully-formed requirement, and diagnose whether the problem is genuinely a substrate problem: a reasoning or judgment gap over fragmented knowledge, not an integration, ML, or reporting problem in disguise.
  • Partner with account and sales teams to shape one well-scoped use case per engagement, built from the customer''s own documents and systems, that can produce a measurable result in 36 weeks.
  • Exit this stage with the customer naming one use case and the KPI it will be judged on not general enthusiasm.
  1. Customer Demonstrations
  • Design and deliver technical demos and proofs-of-concept that ground the pitch in the customer''s own data and systems rather than generic examples.
  • Translate the substrate''s architecture and value proposition (a shared context foundation across every agent, always-current knowledge, customer-hosted data sovereignty, hallucination-free grounded answers) into a story specific to that account and its stakeholders.
  • Present confidently to technical and executive audiences on the customer side, including in high-stakes leadership demos.
  1. Pilot Delivery (Prove stage)
  • Lead pilots inside the customer''s own environment, riding an engagement or cadence that already exists rather than triggering a new procurement cycle.
  • Instrument the pilot against a KPI the customer already reports, and drive it to a number the customer will repeat to their own leadership without your team in the room.
  • Manage pilot scope, timeline and technical risk directly this role builds and debugs, it does not only direct others.
  1. Production Deployment (Establish stage)
  • Own the technical path from a proven pilot to a production deployment: architecture decisions, integrating the customer''s live systems as tools that stay outside the substrate rather than being rebuilt inside it, and governance and data-sovereignty requirements.
  • Identify and scope the next domains that can run on the same substrate, without a rebuild, as the natural expansion path.
  • Exit this stage when the substrate is the customer''s default context layer a standard, not a project.
  1. Cross-Account Technical Leadership
  • Mentor and support other Field-Deployed Engineers; bring technical rigor and consistency across the account portfolio.
  • Turn account-specific patterns into reusable use-case archetypes the rest of the team can apply elsewhere.
  • Apply the team''s stage-gate discipline evidence, not enthusiasm: no move to Prove without a named KPI, no move to Establish without a measured result.

  • Full-arc ownership, comfortable moving between discovery conversations, demo-building, pilot execution and production rollout on the same account this role spans both pre-sales and delivery, not one or the other.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technologist who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing high-quality code, and building scalable, reliable, secure, and performant enterprise SaaS capabilities.


As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a strong individual contributor and technical anchor for the team. You will contribute directly to design and implementation, help shape the technology stack, support the technical roadmap, and partner with engineers, architects, product managers, and engineering leaders to deliver high-impact product capabilities.


This role requires deep proficiency in Java, strong database technology experience, strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. The ideal candidate is comfortable going deep into code, production behavior, performance bottlenecks, observability data, and system design while helping the team make sound technical decisions.


We are looking for an engineer with an enterprise-level mindset who can balance hands-on delivery with technical guidance, contribute to architecture discussions, improve engineering practices, and bring practical insight into AI-assisted engineering, agents, and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities

Hands-on Software Engineering

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality backend services, APIs, distributed components, and cloud-native capabilities for the Ready product.
  • Write clean, maintainable, performant, and well-tested code using Java and modern enterprise engineering practices.
  • Take ownership of complex technical deliverables from design through implementation, testing, release, and production support.
  • Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions with a focus on quality, simplicity, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly learn and apply new technologies, frameworks, tools, and platform capabilities as product and engineering needs evolve.

Technology Stack & Technical Roadmap

  • Contribute to the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the technology stack for the Ready product, including application frameworks, database technologies, messaging, caching, observability, and cloud-native services.
  • Partner with architects and engineering leaders to shape a practical technical roadmap that improves scalability, reliability, performance, developer productivity, and customer experience.
  • Bring strong technical judgment to build-versus-buy decisions, framework selection, modernization efforts, and platform evolution.
  • Help translate product and business needs into sustainable technical designs and implementation plans.

Architecture & Design

  • Design scalable and resilient software components that align with enterprise SaaS architecture principles.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven workflows, data-intensive features, and integration patterns.
  • Identify design risks early and recommend pragmatic solutions that reduce complexity while supporting long-term product growth.
  • Document technical designs, trade-offs, assumptions, and implementation approaches clearly for engineering teams.

Observability, Troubleshooting & Operational Excellence

  • Use observability platforms, logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to understand system behavior and diagnose production issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems across application, database, infrastructure, integration, and deployment layers.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis, incident follow-ups, and reliability improvements that prevent recurring issues.
  • Improve monitoring, telemetry, logging, and service health practices using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar platforms.
  • Support operational readiness through automation, meaningful alerts, clear runbooks, and production-aware engineering practices.

Performance Engineering & Database Technology

  • Tune application and database performance, including query optimization, indexing, connection management, caching, concurrency, transaction handling, and service-level latency improvements.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks using profiling, load testing, benchmarking, database execution plans, and production telemetry.
  • Design reliable and scalable data models using relational database technologies and appropriate data access patterns.
  • Collaborate with teams to improve throughput, latency, resiliency, cost efficiency, and scalability of product services.

AI-First Engineering & Agents

  • Apply AI-assisted development tools to improve software design, coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and developer productivity.
  • Bring practical understanding of AI trends, agents, coding assistants, and intelligent automation into engineering discussions.
  • Identify opportunities where AI and agents can improve engineering workflows, support diagnostics, automate repetitive tasks, or enhance product capabilities.
  • Follow responsible AI practices with attention to security, privacy, quality, reliability, and governance.

Technical Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product managers, quality engineers, SRE, and engineering leaders to deliver reliable product capabilities.
  • Lead focused technical discussions when needed, especially around design choices, implementation approaches, troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design feedback, debugging support, and sharing of engineering best practices.
  • Influence team-level engineering quality through strong hands-on contribution, technical credibility, and practical guidance.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building enterprise-scale software products.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in Java, backend service development, object-oriented design, concurrency, performance tuning, and modern Java frameworks.
  • Strong experience with database technologies, SQL, schema design, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and database performance troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven components, and cloud-native applications.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, database, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong understanding of performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, caching, query tuning, and scalability analysis.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them effectively in production-grade software development.
  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted engineering tools, AI agents, and emerging automation capabilities.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and mentoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers.
  • Experience contributing to technical roadmaps, platform modernization, cloud transformation, or technology stack evolution.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with distributed caching, messaging platforms, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architecture.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development, authentication, authorization, data protection, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers while remaining deeply hands-on in design, coding, debugging, and delivery.

Key Attributes

  • Strong hands-on developer who is ready to write code and solve hard technical problems.
  • Fast learner who can evaluate and adopt new technologies pragmatically.
  • Production-minded engineer with strong focus on reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Practical technical leader who influences through code quality, engineering judgment, and collaboration.
  • Comfortable troubleshooting deep technical issues and driving them to resolution.
  • Curious and forward-looking engineer with strong interest in AI-first development and agent-based automation
