title: OCI AI Architect
jobDescription:
OCI AI Architect - J50839


Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI Architect
Location: Noida
Brief Description
We are looking for an experienced OCI AI Architect to lead the design, architecture and deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and traditional AI/ML solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
This role requires a deep understanding of OCI Architecture, Large Language Models, Agentic and AI/ML frameworks, data engineering, and OCI-native services
The ideal candidate will drive Agentic AI transformation initiatives, architect scalable AI solutions over OCI, and enable intelligent automation that can seamlessly integrate within the operational workflows of Oracle ERP and finance systems.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, Architect and deploy enterprise grade AI/ML and Gen AI solutions using AI Capabilities over OCI platform.
• Architect and implement agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, including multi-agent orchestration and workflow automation.
• Design & implement RAG pipelines, leveraging embeddings, vector search, and enterprise knowledge bases using Oracle Autonomous Database (including 23ai vector capabilities).
• Build and lead development of ML pipelines and LLM fine-tuning pipelines, including parameter-efficient tuning (PEFT) and domain adaptation.
• Architect end-to-end AI solution lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, & feedback loops.
• Define and implement AI governance, responsible AI, and security guardrails, ensuring compliance with enterprise standards.
• Design secure AI deployments using OCI networking, IAM, private endpoints, and data security best practices.
• Provide technical guidance and best practices around MLOps, model versioning, deployment automation, and AI governance.
• Evaluate and adopt emerging AI ecosystem standards (e.g., MCP) to enable scalable and interoperable agentic architectures.
• Evaluating and monitoring LLM outputs, including hallucination detection, response quality scoring, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
• Architect cost-optimized AI solutions by selecting appropriate models, optimizing token usage, and designing efficient inference strategies.
• Design memory strategies for agentic systems, including short-term context, long-term memory, and knowledge persistence.
• Design human-in-the-loop workflows for validation, exception handling, and continuous learning in AI systems.
• Understanding of event-driven and microservices-based architectures for scalable AI systems.
• Define testing strategies for AI systems, including prompt testing, scenario validation, and regression testing.
• Support customer presentations & solution demos, as needed with architectural insights and technical credibility.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, and application teams to identify AI opportunities and deliver AI-first, cloud-native solutions
Skills Required
• 1015 years in Oracle Cloud and AI, with 5+ years of proven and hands-on experience in designing, architecting and deploying AI/ML & Gen AI Solution over OCI AI stack.
• Strong Python programming skills and experience with data processing (JSON, APIs, etc.)
• Strong hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g. Cohere, GPT etc.) & advanced prompt engineering techniques (e.g. Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct).
• Proven experience designing RAG architecture, embeddings-based retrieval, and vector search systems
• Strong understanding Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning.
• Strong expertise in Agentic AI frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph) and multi-agent orchestration patterns
• Working experience with at least 2 OCI Pre-Built AI Services: Vision, Speech, Language, Anomaly Detection, Document Understanding etc.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and architecture principles: data lifecycle, feature stores, model registries, inference serving, feedback loops
• Must have working experience with semantic matching, fuzzy logic, and similarity scoring algorithms (e.g., cosine similarity, Jaccard, Levenshtein distance)
• Strong knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI.
• Must have knowledge of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Proficient in AI/ML/Gen AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain) & Vector DBs (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus).
• Proficient in Agentic AI Frameworks (e.g. CrewAI, AutoGen and multi-agent orchestration workflow)
• Working knowledge with OCI Data Science, OCI Gen AI Service, OCI Gen AI Agents, Oracle ATP, Data Flow (Apache Spark), OCI Functions, API Gateway, and Monitoring
• Must have experience working with Oracle ATP, 23ai Databases and vector queries
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Good to have experience in front end programming languages such as React, Angular or Javascript etc.
• Good to have: Experience with Finance domain solutions.
• Good to Understand Oracle Cloud Deployment, architecture, networking, Security and other essential components
• Good to have: Understanding of emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enabling interoperability between LLMs, tools, and enterprise systems.
Qualifications:
• B.Tech – Computer Science / MCA or equivalent degrees
• Any degree or diploma in AI would be preferred.
• Preferred: Two or more OCI certifications such as: OCI Generative AI Professional, Oracle AI Vector Search Professional, OCI Data Science Professional, OCI Architect Professional.
• Good to have AI Certifications from the following: Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications Developers, Oracle APEX Developer Professional.

Track leads through the funnel and report results and ROI to leadership.
Brand content

Translate FIABs finance, HR, and expanding service offerings into clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for different buyer personas.

Track competitor positioning and market developments in fintech/finops, and B2B services to keep messaging sharp and current.

Proven experience building LinkedIn presence and thought-leadership content for a B2B brand or leader.
Experience working closely with BD/Sales on pipeline generation, lead handoff, and account-based approaches.
Comfortable marketing technology, recruitment/HR, or financial and professional-services offerings to sophisticated B2B buyers.
A bias for personal execution: comfortable writing copy, building campaigns, and getting into the details rather than only directing others.
Data-driven mindset: able to set up and read funnel metrics and adjust tactics based on results.
Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or contractors to deliver on brief and on time.
Strong written communication skills in English, with real editorial judgment on what AI-assisted drafts still need before theyre ready to ship.
A self-starter who takes a loose direction and turns it into a concrete plan, and builds process and structure proactively.

Experience marketing a new product launch, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.
Experience as the first or sole marketing hire in a growing services or technology business.
Familiarity with account-based marketing motions alongside demand generation.
Comfort with design/no-code tools (Canva, basic Figma, website CMS) to move quickly without always relying on a designer.
Exposure to both US and India B2B buyer contexts.
Experience working alongside a fractional or outside CMO/marketing advisor.

descriptionFromApi:
We are looking for a Manager, IT Security to build, operate, and scale a secure, resilient, and audit-ready technology environment - with equal ownership across enterprise IT and information security.
Reporting to the COO, this is a builder-operator role. You will be hands-on in designing systems and processes while simultaneously building the team and structure to scale them. You will own the full spectrum - from internal infrastructure and endpoint management to security engineering, compliance programs, AI security governance, data protection (including DPO responsibilities), and the customer-facing trust posture that enables enterprise revenue.
This role carries a unique advantage and responsibility: you will be securing an organization whose own products - ZTNA, MFA, SSO, virtualization, MDM, biometric authentication, and a secure OS - are the building blocks of enterprise security. That means dogfooding our stack, shaping product security from the inside, and representing our security posture to customers who evaluate us as both a vendor and a security partner.
You will build a defensible security architecture aligned with our product philosophy - secure-by-design digital workspace, identity-first access, and zero-trust principles - while keeping the organization ahead of an evolving threat landscape shaped by AI-driven attacks, software supply chain risks, and increasingly sophisticated adversaries.


Core Ownership Areas
  • Internal IT and infrastructure
  • Security engineering and operations
  • AI and emerging technology security
  • Data protection and privacy (DPO)
  • Compliance and certification programs
  • Product and platform security
  • Customer and regulator-facing security posture


Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise IT Infrastructure Leadership
  • Own and scale global IT operations - end-user computing, networks, cloud infrastructure, and office IT for a distributed workforce.
  • Dogfood our own product stack (ZTNA, MFA, SSO, MDM, virtualization) as the foundation of internal IT architecture - serving as both a validation environment and a reference implementation for customers.
  • Design secure, identity-driven enterprise architecture with conditional access, device posture enforcement, and zero-trust segmentation.
  • Drive adoption of zero-trust and least-privilege models across all infrastructure layers.
  • Ensure high availability, performance, and resilience of internal systems with defined SLA targets.
  • Implement cloud security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWPP) across cloud environments.


2. Security Strategy Operations
  • Define and execute the organizations information security strategy, aligned to business objectives and the evolving threat landscape.
    • Security operations center (SOC) - with AI-augmented monitoring, detection, and response.
    • Vulnerability management and patching with defined SLA-driven remediation timelines.
    • Identity and access governance across internal and product environments.
  • Establish threat-informed defense models aligned to frameworks like MITRE ATTCK.
  • Deploy and evolve AI-native security tooling for automated threat detection, anomaly identification, and intelligent alerting to reduce analyst burden and improve response times.


3. AI Emerging Technology Security
  • Own the security governance framework for AI/ML usage across the organization - both internal tools and product-embedded capabilities.
    • LLM-assisted phishing and deepfake-based social engineering.
    • Prompt injection, data exfiltration via AI tools, and model manipulation risks.
    • Shadow AI usage and ungoverned adoption of generative AI by employees.
  • Define acceptable use policies and technical controls for AI tools (e.g., data classification rules for LLM inputs, approved tool lists, access controls for model endpoints).
  • Evaluate and integrate AI-driven capabilities into the security operations stack - automated triage, behavioral analytics, predictive threat intelligence.
  • Stay current on regulatory developments related to AI governance and data protection (e.g., EU AI Act, emerging regional frameworks).


4. Product Platform Security
  • Partner with engineering to embed secure SDLC practices with security gates at each stage of the development lifecycle.
    • Authentication and authorization layers (MFA, SSO, biometric authentication).
    • ZTNA and VPN / VDI / workspace access components.
    • MDM and endpoint management services.
    • Secure OS and USB-based deployment surfaces.
    • API and cloud-native services.
  • Implement and mature:
    • SAST, DAST, SCA, and SBOM practices with automated integration into CI/CD pipelines.
    • Threat modeling (STRIDE or equivalent) as a standard practice for new features and architecture changes.
  • Own software supply chain security - dependency integrity, build pipeline security, and provenance verification.
  • Act as the internal authority on customer-facing product security posture - particularly critical given that our products are themselves security tools evaluated by CISOs and security teams.


5. Data Protection, Privacy Security (DPO)
  • Serve as the organizations Data Protection Officer (DPO), with accountability for data privacy compliance across all 12 operating countries.
  • Define and enforce data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and encryption strategies (at rest, in transit, and in use) - across products and internal systems.
  • Partner with product and engineering to embed privacy-by-design principles, particularly for products handling customer identity and access data.
  • Own data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) for new products, features, and data processing activities.
  • Ensure alignment between data handling practices and regulatory requirements across all operating geographies (GDPR, Indias DPDP Act, and regional data protection laws).
  • Own data retention, anonymization, and cross-border data transfer policies - including standard contractual clauses (SCCs) and binding corporate rules where required.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for data protection authorities across jurisdictions.


6. Compliance, Risk Governance
  • Lead and maintain certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and regional regulatory requirements across operating geographies.
  • Build audit-ready evidence frameworks - automated where possible - to reduce certification overhead and audit preparation time.
  • Manage:
    • Risk assessments (enterprise + product) with quantified risk scoring.
    • Third-party and vendor risk programs with defined assessment cadence.
    • Software supply chain risk as part of the broader vendor and dependency risk posture.
    • Multi-country regulatory interactions and customer security reviews.


7. Customer Trust External Interface
  • Represent the company in security due diligence discussions with enterprise customers (CISOs, CIOs, Risk leaders) - with the understanding that as a security vendor, our own posture is scrutinized to a higher standard.
  • Own responses to:
    • Security questionnaires.
    • RFP/RFI security sections.
    • Regulatory inquiries.
  • Build a trust narrative that positions our internal security practices as proof of our product philosophy - we secure ourselves with the same tools we sell.
  • Contribute to sales enablement by reducing security-related friction in enterprise deal cycles across all 12 operating countries.


8. Incident Response Resilience
  • Define and operationalize incident response and crisis management frameworks with clear escalation paths and communication protocols.
  • Conduct regular:
    • Tabletop exercises with cross-functional participation.
    • Red team / blue team simulations (including AI-augmented adversary simulations).
  • Ensure alignment between cyber resilience and business continuity / disaster recovery planning.
  • Define and track incident response metrics - Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), and Mean Time to Recover.


9. Security Culture Awareness
  • Build and run a security awareness program for 300+ employees across multiple countries - including phishing simulations, role-specific training, and onboarding security modules.
  • Establish a developer security champions program to distribute security ownership across engineering teams - especially critical in a company whose products are security tools.
  • Foster a culture where security is everyones responsibility, not a bottleneck or afterthought.

The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when its ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

Youll set craft and design-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. Business Goals

This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response - the gap between a high-level "somethings wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. descriptionFromApi:
Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-onSenior AI Engineerto lead the design, development, and production deployment of advanced AI solutionsspanning traditional machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI. You will own end-to-end AI initiatives, from architecture through optimization, deployment, and monitoring, and build scalable, enterprise-grade applications such as conversational AI assistants and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, train, and evaluate ML and deep learning models (RNNs, GRUs, LSTMs, and Transformers such as BERT, T5, GPT) for classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, and NLP tasks.
  • Architect and develop Generative AI and RAG solutions for document search, conversational Q&A, and summarization using frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
  • Implement vector stores (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search), embeddings, and retrieval techniques for grounded, context-aware responses.
  • Optionally fine-tune LLMs using SFT and PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA) on domain-specific datasets.
  • Optimize models via quantization (dynamic/static, INT8) to improve latency and reduce compute overhead.
  • Deploy models into production on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), collaborating with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines for scalability and reliability.
  • Define and track technical and business metrics; monitor model drift and performance, and retrain as needed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data engineering, backend, DevOps, product) and mentor junior engineers; write clean, reproducible, well-documented code.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ yearsof hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or data science, with proven production deployment experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and traditional machine learning algorithms, especially for sequence and NLP tasks.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proficiency with ML/DL libraries (scikit-learn, pandas) and Transformer models / open-source LLMs (e.g., Hugging Face).
  • Practical experience with GenAI tools, RAG frameworks, vector stores, and embeddings.
  • Experience with model quantization, evaluation using statistical and business metrics, and production monitoring.
  • Familiarity with MLflow and CI/CD practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills; able to work independently and collaboratively.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs (SFT, LoRA, QLoRA) on domain-specific datasets.
  • Exposure to MLOps platforms (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, Kubeflow).
  • Familiarity with distributed data processing (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).
  • Experience building enterprise-grade conversational or agentic AI solutions.
  • Familiarity with computer vision and version control (Git).
  • Contributions to research papers, blog posts, or open-source projects in ML/NLP/GenAI.

The specific Statement of Requirement is as follows:

What the role delivers:

  • Architecture across the landscape end-to-end design on ServiceNow (HRSD, Employee Center Pro, Now Assist / Virtual Agent, AI Search, Integration Hub, Flow Designer) and how it connects to SuccessFactors, SAP and analytics. Owns how the pieces fit, not just the ServiceNow box.
  • Translation, both directions — business need into unambiguous, buildable stories for offshore teams; technical trade-offs back into plain language so functional owners see the second-order consequences.
  • Challenge — pushes back on process problems dressed up as build requests, defaults to out-of-the-box before custom, and flags technical debt, licensing and entitlement exposure and localization risk before it is built
  • Delivery direction — works across vendor teams to keep the build aligned to the design
  • Milestone planning — sequences by dependency (foundations journeys AI data retrieval integrations)

The individual you propose Must be — senior and credible with both HR process owners and technical reviewers; assertive and delivery-focused; strategic and holistic; a fresh thinker who challenges assumptions rather than taking orders; and a strong planner who spots the edge cases (part-time staff, contractors, mid-process transfers, multi-country differences) before they become defects.

Must have:

  • Hands-on ServiceNow configuration and development — real depth in HRSD and Employee Center Pro (catalog, workflows, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, scripting, role based logic), able to build and to advise on how the system works underneath.
  • Enterprise-scale ServiceNow architecture for large or distributed organizations.
  • Cross-landscape integration experience — ServiceNow with SuccessFactors / SAP HCM (or close equivalent): data flows, master data, identity and the failure modes when integration data is late or missing.
  • AI and self-service on ServiceNow — Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search and modern deflection design.
  • Proven requirements-to-specification for offshore delivery.
  • Stakeholder facilitation with non-technical owners, and agile delivery with (or leading) offshore vendor teams.
  • Awareness of licensing, entitlement and technical debt, raised proactively — we have been bitten by capability enabled ahead of an entitlement model, and treat that as a hard gate.
  • Advantageous — ITSM cross-domain exposure; multi-country localization and entitlement design; Visier or equivalent analytics; onboarding and offboarding journey delivery; large industrial or oil and gas settings with a mixed office and field workforce.
  • Certifications (advantage, not a substitute for demonstrated skill) — ServiceNow CIS (HR, ITSM, CSM, PPM), CAD, CSA, ITIL 4, ArchX.

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day.

OVERVIEW

The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. Project deliveries

  • Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
  • Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
  • Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
  • Support development of domain-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision-making.

AI Enablement

AI Office

  • Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
  • Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption
  • Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D&T leaders.

Platform Evaluation & Governance

  • Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
  • Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
  • Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
  • Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

jobDescription:
We enable financial institutions to become digital leaders.

As a professional team of global scale, we work with best clients for great and exciting projects, in an environment where we learn amazing things every day. Each code, each voice, each contribution, each challenge, each success is celebrated here.

We welcome candidates who share our values, have the skills and are passionate to enjoy our journey to build the digital future of finance, together.

About the job:

The Dev Practice Lead defines, governs, and continuously improves enterprise development standards and engineering guardrails to enable consistent, secure, and highquality software delivery across products, projects, and regions.

This role provides practice leadership through standards, templates, readiness criteria, coaching models, and continuous improvement mechanisms and early risk visibility without owning technical architecture, delivery execution, timelines, scope decisions, or resource management.


What you will be doing:

Engineering Governance & AIEnabled Development Practices

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to jointly define and align coding standards, engineering practices, and G&R (Guidance & Review) models that meet product and delivery teams needs while remaining consistent with enterprise objectives.
  • Identify effective engineering and AIenabled software development best practices emerging across teams and drive their standardization and adoption across the organization.
  • Define and formalize AI usage guidelines (including GitHub Copilot Cloud Agent workflows), by working closely with engineering teams, ensuring outputs are traceable, verifiable, and supported by appropriate human validation while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Facilitate the transition to modern and scalable development practices, ensuring a consistent and traceable execution model across teams.
  • Strengthen ShiftLeft practices and support teams in adopting early validation approaches to improve testability, accelerate feedback cycles, and reduce late-stage defects.
  • Collaborate across BA, QE and Product CoE teams to ensure end-to-end SDLC alignment and a consistent, traceable requirement-to-test lifecycle.
  • Review and refine Guidance & Review (G&R) and MakerChecker practices to ensure they are clear, effective, and consistently applied.

Adoption, Change Management & Enablement

  • Drive adoption of improved engineering practices through structured enablement, communication, and targeted coaching.
  • Work with Technical Leads, Software Development Managers and Implementation Heads to ensure new practices are understood, applied consistently, and embedded into daily workflows.
  • Act as a change facilitator, ensuring transformation initiatives are practical and sustainable.
  • Define and track standardization and adoption metrics, including SDLC adherence, quality gate usage, deviation visibility and AI adoption levels.
  • Establish early warning mechanisms (e.g., RAG signals) to provide visibility into process gaps, inconsistent practices and emerging risks.

Engineering Capability & Team Enablement

  • Support upskilling of engineering teams in modern development practices, AIassisted workflows and structured engineering discipline.
  • Collaborate with the training team, providing input on capability expectations, identify skill gaps and development priorities.
  • Review, refine, and mature roles, responsibilities, and RACI models to ensure clarity, consistency, and accountability across engineering functions.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Ability to drive alignment and adoption across multiple engineering teams in a matrix organization without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to act as a change agent, influencing behaviors and ways of working at scale
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills to bring teams together and co-create solutions
  • Coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Systems thinking with the ability to identify systemic delivery issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced delivery environments.

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (enterprise product and/or multi-client implementation environments), with 35 years in engineering practice leadership or cross-team technical enablement.
  • Experience in Banking, Financial Services, or FinTech industries is highly preferred due to complex regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft technologies (e.g., Dynamics 365, Power BI, or related ecosystem) is a plus.
  • Proven ability to define and drive adoption of engineering standards, shift-left quality and readiness gates.
  • Strong technical background .NET or Java, with ability to operate boths.
  • Experience enabling automation and AI-assisted development in delivery environments.
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot Cloud Agent is mandatory
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, VS Code AI) and ability to guide their use; familiarity with MCP-enabled workflows is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of unit testing, testability, and quality practices.
  • Experience with Jira/GitHub, version control, and code review workflows.
  • Familiarity with Agile, SAFe, and modern engineering practices.

What we are offering:

  • Remote Freedom, Your Way: At VeriPark we believe in the power of talent, no matter where it resides. Design your ideal workspace and achieve the perfect work-life balance.
  • Performance-Linked Bonus: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed! Enjoy a performance-linked bonus as a testament to your dedication!
  • Employee Wellbeing: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including Remote Work Support, Health Insurance, Care Program, and Employee Wellbeing Program with Heltia or MantraCare Membership. We care you!
  • Birthday Leave, Because You Matter: We value your special moments! Take the day off on your birthday and treat yourself.
  • Unleash Your Potential: Develop yourself with VeriPark Academy opportunities; webinars, and in-house training sessions.
  • Together Culture: Even in a remote world, we cultivate connections through engaging face-to-face gatherings as well as online fun events two times in a year. Special information sharing environment where you can update & align yourself.
  • Reward & Recognition, Celebrating Your Success: Your contributions deserve to be recognized! Be part of our Reward & Recognition Program, featuring exciting awards such as a One-Week Work & Travel Experience and other experience-based rewards.

About the Role

SRFC is looking to appoint an experienced and highly driven Chief Digital Officer (CDO) to lead the organisation's digital transformation journey and build the next generation of its digital business.

The ideal candidate will have 10–15+ years of experience in digital transformation, financial services, lending, fintech, banking, digital sourcing, customer acquisition, or technology-led business growth.

This is a strategic leadership role for an individual who can understand both business and technology and translate emerging technologies into practical, scalable business solutions.

The CDO will be responsible for developing and executing SRFC's digital strategy, strengthening digital sourcing capabilities, improving customer acquisition journeys, and identifying technology-led opportunities that can significantly enhance business growth and operational efficiency.

  • Develop and drive SRFC's overall digital transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to digitise and optimise business processes across the organisation.
  • Establish a scalable digital operating model aligned with SRFC's business objectives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their practical application within financial services.
  • Drive a culture of innovation, digital adoption, and data-driven decision-making.

2. Digital Sourcing & Customer Acquisition

  • Build and scale digital sourcing capabilities for loan and financial-service products.
  • Develop strategies to increase digital customer acquisition, lead generation, conversion, and retention.
  • Identify new digital channels, partnerships, ecosystems, and distribution models.
  • Improve customer journeys through technology, automation, analytics, and personalised engagement.
  • Leverage digital platforms to improve sourcing efficiency and reduce customer acquisition costs.

3. Technology-Led Business Growth

  • Identify and implement technology-led opportunities for business growth and revenue enhancement.
  • Work closely with business teams to understand existing challenges and convert them into scalable digital solutions.
  • Evaluate opportunities around APIs, AI/ML, analytics, automation, decision engines, digital journeys, and platform-based models.
  • Develop digital products and capabilities that can create competitive differentiation for SRFC.

  • Build and manage relationships with fintechs, technology providers, digital platforms, and strategic partners.

Job Title: Project Engineer Substations Engineering

Location: Chennai
Experience: 11 to 20Years

Industry: Power / Electrical / Substation Engineering


Job Summary:


We are looking for an experienced Project Engineer Substations Engineering to handle secondary engineering and protection & control design activities for AIS/GIS substations. The role involves substation design, technical documentation, vendor coordination, customer interaction, tender/project engineering and support during erection and commissioning.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Review tender documents, technical specifications and prepare design intent documents.
  • Prepare Protection SLDs, schematics, circuit diagrams, wiring/termination diagrams and cable schedules.
  • Develop signal lists, trip matrices, logics, interlocks and relay ordering information.
  • Design and review Control & Relay panels, auxiliary AC/DC systems and substation interfaces.
  • Perform CT/VT sizing, voltage-drop calculations, cable sizing and related engineering studies.
  • Review and technically evaluate vendor drawings, offers and equipment documentation.
  • Coordinate with engineering, project, SCM, vendors, customers and other design teams.
  • Support FAT/SAT, customer approvals, site visits, erection and commissioning activities.
  • Handle SCADA/RTU, Bay Controller, Teleprotection and primary equipment interfaces.
  • Prepare BoQ, engineering effort estimates and support tender costing.
  • Identify technical risks/opportunities and ensure timely completion of engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with IEC/IEEE standards, quality requirements and safety-by-design principles.
  • Contribute to OPEX, process improvement and initiatives to reduce engineering effort.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Substation Secondary Engineering and Protection & Control.
  • Hands-on experience in AIS/GIS substation design.
  • Expertise in Protection SLD, schematics, control & relay panels and cable engineering.
  • Knowledge of CT/VT sizing, AC/DC auxiliary systems and relay engineering.
  • Knowledge of SCADA/RTU, Bay Controller and Teleprotection interfaces.
  • Experience in vendor drawing review, technical offer evaluation and customer approvals.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools and E3.
  • Good knowledge of IEC/IEEE standards.
  • Strong project coordination, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and guide/coordinate engineering activities across teams and countries.

Preferred Profile:


Candidates with 11–15 years of relevant experience in Substation Engineering / Protection & Control / Secondary Engineering, preferably with experience in both tendering and project execution, will be preferred.

Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company that is simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system.

Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers.

Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, Limerick in Ireland and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective and efficient.

OUR MISSION & VALUES

Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity

JOB POSITION

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

  • Develop and maintain microservice architecture and API management solutions using REST and gRPC for seamless deployment of AI solutions.
  • Design and implement AI pipelines using both predictive modelling and agentic framework.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and product managers, to acquire, process, and manage data for AI/ML model integration and optimization.
  • Design and implement robust, scalable, and enterprise-grade data pipelines to support state-of-the-art AI/ML models.
  • Debug, optimize, and enhance machine learning models, ensuring quality assurance and performance improvements.
  • Familiarity with tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi for efficient infrastructure management.
  • Create and manage CI/CD pipelines using Git-based platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to ensure streamlined development workflows.
  • Operate container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes, with advanced configurations and service mesh implementations, for scalable ML workload deployments.
  • Design and build scalable LLM inference architectures, employing GPU memory optimization techniques and model quantization for efficient deployment.
  • Engage in advanced prompt engineering and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), focusing on semantic retrieval and chatbot development.
  • Document model architectures, hyperparameter optimization experiments, and validation results using version control and experiment tracking tools like MLflow or DVC.
  • Research and implement cutting-edge LLM optimization techniques, such as quantization and knowledge distillation, ensuring efficient model performance and reduced computational costs.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to develop innovative and effective natural language processing solutions, specializing in text classification, sentiment analysis, and topic modeling.
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests for machine learning models, analyzing results to drive strategic improvements and decisions.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI technologies, integrating new methodologies and frameworks to continually enhance the AI engineering function.
  • Contribute to creating specialized AI solutions in healthcare, leveraging domain-specific knowledge for task adaptation and deployment.

QUALIFICATION

Minimum education: Bachelors degree in any Engineering Stream
Specialized training, certifications, and/or other special requirements: Nice to have

Masters in data science or PHD is good to have
Preferred education: Computer Science/Engineering.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum relevant experience – 15+ Years in Datascience, GenAI in end to end architecture solution design

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

Technical Skills:

  • Ability to understand availability metrics like 99.99% and architect systems that satisfy the required availability.
  • Understanding of NFR (Non-Functional Requirements) with the ability to architect systems that meet NFR requirements such as availability, disaster recovery (DR), and an understanding of RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
  • Able to work on RFP (Request for Proposals) and RFI (Request for Information).
  • Capability to define and create various architectures including technical, deployment, security, and functional overview. Proficiency in crafting As-Is and To-Be system architectures, along with authentication and authorization flows.
  • Define strategies for scale-out and scale-up.
  • Define and conduct load and stress testing, and define physical architecture.
  • Develop logging strategies.
  • Awareness of popular design frameworks such as SOLID.
  • Familiarity with cloud architectural patterns.
  • Ability to estimate effort for large program and define resource loading
  • Advanced proficiency in Python with expertise in data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Extensive experience with LLM frameworks (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain) and prompt engineering techniques
  • Experience with big data processing using Spark for large-scale data analytics
  • Version control and experiment tracking using Git and MLflow
  • Software Engineering & Development: Advanced proficiency in Python, familiarity with Go or Rust, expertise in microservices, test-driven development, and concurrency processing.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and container orchestration (Kubernetes) with Helm and service mesh implementations.
  • LLM Infrastructure & Deployment: Proficiency in LLM serving platforms such as vLLM and FastAPI, model quantization techniques, and vector database management.
  • MLOps & Deployment: Utilization of containerization strategies for ML workloads, experience with model serving tools like TorchServe or TF Serving, and automated model retraining.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong grasp of advanced cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and network security for ML systems.
  • LLM Project Experience: Expertise in developing chatbots, recommendation systems, translation services, and optimizing LLMs for performance and security.
  • General Skills: Python, SQL, knowledge of machine learning frameworks (Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch), and experience with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP.
  • Experience in creating LLD for the provided architecture.
  • Experience working in microservices based architecture.

Domain Expertise:

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistics, probability, linear algebra, and optimization
  • Deep understanding of ML and LLM development lifecycle, including fine-tuning and evaluation
  • Expertise in feature engineering, embedding optimization, and dimensionality reduction
  • Advanced knowledge of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical hypothesis testing
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search implementation
  • Proficiency in LLM optimization techniques including quantization and knowledge distillation
  • Understanding of MLOps practices for model deployment and monitoring

Professional Competencies:

  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to solve complex ML challenges
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting technical findings to diverse audiences
  • Experience translating business requirements into data science solutions
  • Project management skills for coordinating ML experiments and deployments
  • Strong collaboration abilities for working with cross-functional teams
  • Dedication to staying current with latest ML research and best practices
  • Ability to mentor and share knowledge with team members

THE CARELON PROMISE

Aligning with our brand belief of ‘limitless minds are our biggest asset’, we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates.

It is our strong belief that one is committed to a role when it is not just what the role entails, but also what lies in its periphery that completes the value circle for an associate.

This world of limitless opportunities thrives in an environment that fosters growth and well-being, and gives you purpose and the feeling of belonging.

  • An inspiring culture built on innovation, creativity, and freedom.
  • Holistic well-being
  • Comprehensive range of rewards and recognitions
  • Competitive health and medical insurance coverage
  • Best-in-class amenities and workspaces
  • Policies designed with associates at the center.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a Senior Manager, Data Science to lead the Forecasting team within the AI & Data Science organization. This role will be accountable for setting the data science strategy, developing and leading a high-performing team, and partnering product, program, operations, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and other business stakeholders to deliver enterprise forecasting, uncertainty-aware decision support, scenario planning, and AI-enabled decision automation capabilities across Amgen.
As a senior data science leader, this role blends people leadership, scientific rigor, modern AI fluency, and product-minded execution. The Senior Manager will identify high-impact forecasting and operational decision opportunities, shape them into an actionable portfolio, guide rapid prototype-to-production delivery, and ensure solutions are adopted, measured, governed, and continuously improved based on real-world performance and business value.
The role is well suited to a leader who has built and managed data science or AI teams, delivered production-grade AI/ML solutions with measurable business impact, and can operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional environments. This leader will help Amgen advance AI-native forecasting and decision-support capabilities while supporting the company''s "every patient, every time" mandate.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The Forecasting team within AI & Data Science is a cross-functional team focused on building AI-native forecasting, simulation, and decision-support capabilities for Amgen. The team partners closely with business, operations, and scientific stakeholders to understand enduring planning challenges, prototype solutions quickly, measure impact rigorously, and deploy reliable systems that inform real business decisions.
Our charter is to identify high-value forecasting and decision automation opportunities, build scalable AI/ML products that can support them reliably, and continuously improve these systems based on real-world performance, user adoption, forecast quality, decision quality, operational efficiency, and measurable business value.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists, AI/ML scientists, and analytics professionals, establishing clear priorities, high standards, career development plans, and an inclusive, accountable team culture.

  • 12+ years of professional experience delivering data science, machine learning, forecasting, AI, analytics, or decision-support solutions that created measurable business value.

Role Description:

The role is responsible for leading and charting the course for the Global Supply Chain Serialization Domain. SAP Serialization Solutions Lead will design, implement, and manage serialization solutions that ensure product integrity, regulatory compliance, and supply chain transparency. This role will be key contributor to Serialization Product Team serving as technical consultant as well as liaison between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring technical solutions align with compliance requirements, operational needs, and strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP Advanced Track Trace for Pharmaceuticals (ATTP), Tracelink, SAP ICH (Information Collaboration Hub) or equivalent serialization systems, with strong technical background, business analysis and client-facing skills to translate requirements into scalable, reliable solutions.

Roles Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, configuration, and support of SAP ATTP (Serialization), SAP ICH, and related systems to meet global regulatory and business requirements.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications for serialization and supply chain traceability.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of serialization solutions, including integration with ERP, manufacturing, packaging, and partner systems.
  • Ensure compliance with DSCSA, EU FMD, and other regional/global serialization regulations.
  • Ensure adoption of AI driven tools and collaborating with business to identify AI driven use cases.
  • Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including those in the US and other international locations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, understanding needs, gathering requirements, and providing thought leadership.
  • Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, and requirements-gathering sessions to capture functional and compliance need to be maintained and prioritized in a Product Backlog.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into business-friendly language, facilitating alignment across IT and business functions.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure serialization solutions drive measurable business value.
  • Maintain system documentation, business process workflows, and compliance reporting.
  • Ensure cross-team alignment and manage risks, escalations, and interdependencies.
  • Work with Operation Team to ensure proper Serialization system monitoring, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead vendor and partner relationships, ensuring quality delivery and alignment with business objectives.
  • Build and maintain relationships across IT, business units, and enterprise leadership to align strategy and execution.
  • Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing across IT and business analyst teams.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Masters degree with 8 - 10 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field OR
  • Bachelors degree with 10 - 14 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field OR
  • Diploma with 14 - 18 years of experience in Business, Engineering, IT or related field

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience with at least 5 years focused on SAP ATTP, ICH and serialization ecosystem.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP ERP (ECC/S4), SAP EWM, supply chain processes, and integrations with packaging as well as CMO and Logistics partners.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical/life sciences regulatory requirements for serialization and track-and-trace (DSCSA, EU FMD, Brazil ANVISA, etc.).
  • Experience working in GxP or other regulated environments (e.g., pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare).
  • Proven track record as a business analyst or client-facing IT leader, bridging gaps between technology and business.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience in a leadership role within a pharmaceutical or technology organization
  • Extensive experience in software development lifecycle.
  • Strong analytic/critical-thinking and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Established business partnerships and IS governance practices involving senior business stakeholders
  • Broad working knowledge of key IS domains and layers

Professional Certifications (please mention if the certification is preferred or mandatory for the role):

  • SAFe Agile Practitioner (preferred)

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Strong transformation and change management experience.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills.
  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
  • Team-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals.
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills.
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams

Shift Information:

This position requires you to work a later shift and may be assigned a second or third shift schedule. Candidates must be willing and able to work during evening or night shifts, as required based on business requirements.

descriptionFromApi:
Staff Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) sit at the intersection of enterprise customer environments and a fast-moving internal product. They are senior technical leaders who own ambiguous, high-impact problems that span customer engagements, product direction, and engineering execution. They are accountable not only for getting customers to production, but for using what is learned in the field to shape reusable product capabilities, technical strategy, and delivery quality across multiple teams.
This role is best suited for engineers who want to combine hands-on technical depth with broad influence: defining or changing strategy when customer reality reveals a gap, guiding technical decisions across teams, and translating field insight into durable product and engineering improvements.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Responsibilities
Customer and business impact
  • Own the most complex customer engagements and technical workstreams, especially where the problem, solution, or path to production is ambiguous
  • Build deep understanding of customer architecture, business goals, constraints, and definition of success, and use that understanding to shape the technical approach rather than only execute within a predefined one
  • Act as a trusted technical counterpart to customers engineering leaders, internal product and engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders when navigating complex tradeoffs, risks, and priorities
Technical leadership and execution
  • Lead architectural design for customer-facing solutions and platform capabilities within the FDE domain, balancing hands-on implementation with technical decision-making across multiple teams
  • Take ambiguous, high-level problems and turn them into clear technical direction, implementation plans, milestones, and ownership boundaries that enable execution at quality and speed
  • Continue to write and review production-quality code, troubleshoot complex failures, and set a high bar for correctness, maintainability, observability, and operational readiness in the systems and integrations this role touches
  • Identify systemic issues in tooling, architecture, or delivery and drive durable fixes that improve outcomes across engagements rather than solving each issue as a one-off
Product and roadmap influence
  • Use field engagements to surface domain-level patterns, product gaps, and technical risks, and translate them into actionable proposals, design direction, and roadmap input
  • Influence short- to mid-term technical vision for the FDE domain, partnering with Product and Engineering leaders to balance customer impact, time-to-market, technical debt, and long-term platform quality
  • Help determine which field-learned patterns should remain engagement-specific and which should become reusable product capabilities, standards, or platform investments
Cross-functional leadership
  • Lead focused cross-functional workstreams with Product and Engineering, especially where field experience is necessary to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, and deliver the right outcome
  • Drive consensus on large, abstract, or contentious technical issues that affect multiple teams, and resolve deadlocks through strong judgment, clear reasoning, and durable written artifacts
  • Create high-quality technical artifacts such as designs, decision logs, and proposals that align stakeholders and raise the standard for how teams communicate and execute
Organizational impact
  • Act as a force multiplier for the broader organization by mentoring senior engineers, sharing best practices across teams, and helping others make strong technical decisions in this domain
  • Establish or improve mechanisms, standards, and operating practices that help teams make high-quality decisions and deliver resilient solutions independently
  • Model MongoDBs leadership principles through clarity, accountability, customer obsession, and strong cross-functional partnership in situations of high ambiguity and consequence
Qualifications
Basic qualifications
  • 9+ years of relevant engineering experience, including hands-on work in production systems and complex customer or enterprise environments
  • Demonstrated success leading technical domains or initiatives that span multiple teams, with ownership of technical direction and delivery outcomes
  • Strong experience designing and implementing production-grade integrations, platforms, or distributed systems in ambiguous environments
  • Strong technical judgment, including the ability to balance customer impact, speed, maintainability, and operational risk
  • Ability to shape technical direction based on customer and business context, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and raise the bar for other engineers through mentorship and technical leadership
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% to customer sites as needed for on-site engagements, technical reviews, and executive or customer presentations
Preferred qualifications
  • Experience with LLMs, agent frameworks, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, or deploying AI systems in production enterprise environments
  • Prior experience in a forward-deployed engineering role or a similarly hybrid role spanning customer environments, product influence, and hands-on engineering execution
  • Experience leading multi-team technical initiatives from problem definition through adoption, especially in environments with significant ambiguity or cross-functional dependency

jobDescription:

Synergy is undergoing a significantenterprise-wide transformation , leveraging AI, data, and modern digitalplatforms to reimagine how complex operations, decision-making, and userinteractions are designed and delivered.
Our Enterprise AI Platform sits at the centreof this transformation. It brings together advanced analytics, AI-driveninsights, and enterprise workflows to enable smarter, faster, and moreconfident decisions across the organization. However, the success of thistransformation depends not just on powerful technologybut on howintuitively and effectively people can use it .
We believe AI should reduce complexity,remove friction, and augment human decision-making , not add cognitiveburden. User experience is therefore a strategic lever , not a downstreamactivity. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that AI capabilitiestranslate into clear value, trust, and adoption through thoughtful,user-centred design.
Role Overview
We are looking for a UX Leader toown and shape the user experience of a large-scale Enterprise AI Platform .This role is responsible for deeply understanding user needs, identifyingfriction across journeys, and translating insights into a clear, prioritizedUX roadmap that drives adoption, usability, and business value.
This is not a visual design role. The focusis on usability, experience strategy, and user outcomes , ensuring thatadvanced AI capabilities are delivered through intuitive, efficient, andtrustworthy experiences for enterprise users.
Key Responsibilities
1. UX Strategy Roadmap Ownership
  • Define and own the end-to-end UX vision and strategy for the Enterprise AI Platform.
  • Create and maintain a UX roadmap covering usability, workflows, information architecture, and experience improvements.
  • Align UX priorities with product strategy, AI capabilities, and business objectives .
2. Deep User Understanding Friction Removal
  • Develop a deep understanding of users, their context, pain points, and decision-making .
  • Identify and remove friction, complexity, and cognitive load across critical user journeys.
  • Continuously simplify workflows while balancing enterprise-scale requirements and functional depth.
3. User Research Insights
  • Lead qualitative and quantitative user research across the product lifecycle (interviews, usability testing, journey mapping, prototype validation, analytics).
  • Create and maintain personas, user journeys, and experience blueprints .
  • Translate insights into actionable UX improvements with measurable impact on adoption, efficiency, and satisfaction.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, and Business teams to shape features from concept to delivery.
  • Lead design thinking and co-creation workshops to solve complex experience challenges.
  • Represent the UX perspective in product and roadmap discussions , influencing decisions early.
5. UX Governance Best Practices
  • Establish and champion user-centered design principles, standards, and best practices across the platform.
  • Guide teams on information architecture, interaction patterns, and usability heuristics .
  • Ensure experience consistency and quality as the platform evolves and scales.
6. DataDriven Decision Making
  • Define and track UX metrics such as usability, task success, adoption, error reduction, and satisfaction.
  • Use data and user feedback to validate design decisions and prioritize improvements.
  • Link UX outcomes to business KPIs in partnership with product and analytics teams.
7. Leadership Mentorship
  • Mentor and guide UX designers and researchers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement .
  • Shape effective collaboration models between UX, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Advocate a UX-first mindset , ensuring experience is considered from inceptionnot as a downstream activity.
Experience Skills
  • 12+ years of experience in UX, Product Design, or UX Research , preferably on complex enterprise or B2B platforms.
  • Proven ability to identify user needs, remove friction, and improve usability at scale .
  • Strong expertise in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing .
  • Experience defining and executing UX roadmaps in collaboration with senior product stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled products, data-intensive platforms, or enterprise workflows is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and influence skills.
Mindset Attributes
  • Deep curiosity about users and their problems , not just interfaces.
  • Systems thinker comfortable working across journeys, workflows, and platforms .
  • Pragmatic and outcome-driven, balancing ideal UX with real-world constraints.
  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for experience outcomes.
Why This Role Matters
The Enterprise AI Platform is foundationalto Synergys AI-first strategy. Its success depends on how effectively userscan understand, trust, and act on AI-driven insights . This role ensuresthat AI innovation is matched with exceptional usability, clarity, andexperience quality turning capability into real business impact.

  • Ensuring all regulatory filings are duly validated for accurate timely submissions

Salesforce Professional Services is building a Global Solutions CoE to create a more consistent, scalable, and predictable way to shape, scope, estimate, and deliver Professional Services (ProServe) programs.
We are looking for a Practice Domain Overlay Manager to make sure the CoE model is not generic. This role brings the required product, industry, regulatory, and domain depth into scoping and estimation so that our standards work in real customer situations.
This role does not own every product or every industry. Instead, it owns the process of identifying where specialized input is needed, capturing that input into reusable patterns, and ensuring the CoE model reflects real delivery complexity.
The right candidate understands how Salesforce programs vary by cloud, industry, geography, regulatory environment, and customer maturity - and can turn those differences into practical scoping and estimation guidance the field can actually use.
What You Will Do
1. Identify Where Domain Expertise Is Required
You will define when a deal needs additional practice or domain input during scoping.
Examples:
  • Data Cloud program with complex source systems and identity resolution
  • Agentforce program with unclear automation boundaries or trust requirements
  • Health / Life Sciences program with regulatory or data privacy considerations
  • Public Sector program with procurement, compliance, or security constraints
  • Financial Services program with sensitive data, controls, or integration complexity
  • Multi-cloud program involving Sales, Service, Data, Marketing, Commerce, MuleSoft, or Industry Clouds
Your job is to make these triggers explicit so the field knows when to pull in the right expertise.
2. Build Product and Industry Overlay Patterns
You will create practical overlays that sit on top of the core CoE model.
Each overlay should answer:
  • What is different for this product, industry, or domain
  • What additional discovery questions are required
  • What scoping assumptions should be added
  • What roles or skills are typically needed
  • What risks should be flagged early
  • What SOW language or exclusions are required
  • What delivery dependencies must be confirmed before signature
Examples of overlays:
  • Data Cloud readiness overlay
  • Agentforce scoping overlay
  • Regulated industry overlay
  • Public Sector delivery overlay
  • Integration complexity overlay
  • Migration / data readiness overlay
  • Multi-cloud transformation overlay
  • Change and adoption overlay
3. Translate Practice Knowledge Into Reusable Assets
You will work with Practices and domain SMEs to convert expertise into usable CoE assets.
Expected outputs:
  • Discovery questions
  • Scoping checklists
  • Estimation factors
  • Role and skill assumptions
  • Risk indicators
  • SOW assumptions and exclusions
  • Delivery readiness checkpoints
  • Reference examples from past programs
This role is not about creating long documents. The goal is to create short, reusable assets that can be embedded into scoping workflows, tools, agents, and playbooks.
4. Maintain the Domain Pattern Library
You will own the structure and quality of the domain pattern library.
The library should include:
  • Product-specific scoping guidance
  • Industry-specific considerations
  • Regulatory and compliance triggers
  • Common risks and mitigation patterns
  • Standard assumptions and exclusions
  • Recommended SMEs / practices to engage
  • Reusable examples from successful programs
You will ensure assets are current, easy to find, and practical enough for field use.
5. Support Better Estimation Accuracy
You will help improve estimates by identifying domain-specific effort drivers.
Examples:
  • Number and quality of data sources
  • Number of integrations
  • Number of clouds involved
  • Customer operating model maturity
  • Regulatory review requirements
  • Testing and validation intensity
  • Migration complexity
  • Localization / regional requirements
  • AI governance and trust requirements
  • Change management and adoption effort
Your role is to make sure these drivers are not missed during estimation.
6. Improve Scoping Quality for Complex Programs
You will help prevent common scoping misses.
Examples:
  • Data migration underestimated
  • Integration effort treated as standard
  • Security / compliance review missed
  • Testing effort too light
  • Customer dependencies not documented
  • Change management excluded when adoption risk is high
  • Product capability assumptions not validated
  • Agentforce use cases scoped without clear human-in-the-loop design
  • Fixed-fee risk accepted without enough clarity
Your job is to make these risks visible before the deal is signed.
7. Partner Across the Ecosystem
This role is highly cross-functional and must work closely with peer organizations.

GDC
Validate whether domain patterns are executable at scale and reflect offshore / distributed delivery realities.

Align domain overlays with governance checkpoints, delivery controls, and quality expectations.

Ensure domain overlays align to priority offerings, market plays, and repeatable solution motions.
PS Operations
Validate staffing, resource, and operational assumptions tied to each overlay.

Ensure field-facing guidance supports faster qualification, cleaner discovery, and better deal progression.

Capture what is working in live deals and feed lessons back into the pattern library.

  • Common product and industry scoping misses are reduced
  • Domain-specific effort drivers are included in estimates
  • Scoping and SOW assumptions are clearer and more complete
  • Practice knowledge becomes reusable instead of tribal
  • CoE tools and agents use domain logic, not generic prompts
  • Programs are better shaped before they move into delivery
  • The domain pattern library becomes a trusted source for the field

  • 13+ years of experience in Salesforce consulting, enterprise architecture, solutioning, delivery leadership, or professional services and 7+ years in Salesforce
  • Strong understanding of how Salesforce programs differ by cloud, industry, region, and customer maturity
  • Experience working across multiple Salesforce clouds or enterprise platforms

  • Ability to identify hidden effort drivers and delivery risks early
  • Experience working with product / practice SMEs and translating their input into practical field guidance
  • Strong written communication skills; able to create clear, reusable templates and checklists
  • Ability to work across global teams and matrixed organizations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating playbooks, reusable assets, accelerators, or scoping frameworks

You will serve as a Lead/Principal AI Technical Architect at Virtusa. Your primary mission is to design the technical blueprint for core platforms, with a heavy focus on scaling AI, Generative AI, and autonomous AI agents across high-volume data systems safely, securely, and cost-effectively.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design Technical Architecture: Create high-level technical blueprints, component standards, and integration patterns for Virtusa's platforms to guide engineering teams.
  • Build the AI Strategy: Architect how AI, Generative AI, and multi-agent systems are builtincluding RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agent workflows, memory systems, and human-in-the-loop safety.
  • Establish Standards & Safety: Define technical guidelines for security, privacy, data governance, and Responsible AI (guardrails, cost tracking, access control, and auditing).
  • Evaluate & Innovate: Run Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to test new technologies (e.g., vector databases, LLM models, frameworks) and guide "build vs. buy" decisions.
  • Lead & Mentor: Provide technical leadership, conduct design reviews, and ensure consistent, high-quality engineering practices across development teams.

Core Qualifications


  • Background: 8+ years in software engineering, application development, or technical architecture for distributed systems.
  • Data Scale: Experience with enterprise-scale systems and multi-terabyte database environments (relational and non-relational).
  • Cloud Expertise: Deep knowledge of cloud platforms—specifically Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, security, networking).
  • GenAI & Agent Systems: Hands-on experience with LLMs, vector search, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (e.g., Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Model Context Protocol).
  • Governance & Security: Experience with AI threat modeling, evaluation metrics (accuracy, latency, groundedness), and Responsible AI patterns.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear guidance for both technical engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Job Summary
We are currently seeking an Agentforce Architect to join our team in Karnataka, India.
Responsibilities
  • Own end-to-end solution architecture across Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced.
  • Architect agent-assisted and agentic workflows across opportunity, configuration, pricing, quoting, contracting, ordering and revenue lifecycle processes.
  • Design agent orchestration patterns, including tool/function calling, workflow delegation, multi-agent patterns, state management and memory.
  • Architect integration of Agentforce with Salesforce automation, Apex, Flow, APIs, MuleSoft and external enterprise services.
  • Define appropriate use of LLMs, deterministic logic, workflow engines and traditional automation, rather than defaulting all use cases to generative AI.
  • Design context engineering and retrieval strategies, including structured/unstructured grounding, retrieval depth, metadata filtering and relevance optimization.
  • Establish secure agent action patterns using least-privilege access, guardrails, validation, approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop mechanisms.
  • Define AI evaluation frameworks covering answer quality, grounding, hallucination, task completion, tool selection, latency and business outcomes.
  • Establish observability across agent reasoning paths, actions, integration failures, token/credit consumption and operational performance.
  • Assess model and platform trade-offs across quality, latency, context window, cost, privacy and enterprise constraints.
  • Architect resilient action layers and transactional integration patterns for revenue processes where consistency and recoverability are critical.
  • Advise programs on consumption-based economics, AI credit/token optimization and architectural approaches to control run-time cost.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams.
  • Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists.
Required Technical Expertise
  • Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts.
  • Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management.
  • Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture.
  • Agent orchestration and tool/function calling.
  • Multi-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns.
  • Agent state, short/long-term memory and session/context management.
  • MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability concepts/patterns.
  • RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization.
  • Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering.
  • Evaluation frameworks and AI observability.
  • AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least-privilege action design.
  • LLM model selection and architectural trade-offs.
  • Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking.
  • Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency.
  • Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection.
Preferred Qualifications
  • 15+ years overall technology experience; 10+ years in Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud architecture.
  • Proven experience architecting enterprise CPQ / Quote-to-Cash implementations.
  • Salesforce Application/System/Technical Architect credentials strongly preferred.
  • Agentforce and Revenue Cloud-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience.
  • Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred.
  • Ability to communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders.
