descriptionFromApi:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.


You Are

You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle.


You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use.


At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows
  • Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization
  • Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing
  • Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes
  • Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints
  • Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle
  • Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements
  • Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices

The Impact You Will Have

  • Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows
  • Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort
  • Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization
  • Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow
  • Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company
  • Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines
  • Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in silicon design environments
  • Proven experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent platforms, LLM orchestrations, or autonomous software agent systems in production settings
  • Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell
  • Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows
  • Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus
  • Experience with Silicon Lifecycle Management concepts such as in-chip sensing, telemetry, and analytics is a strong plus

Who You Are

  • You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow
  • You prototype fast and iterate based on real feedback, not theoretical requirements, and you know the difference between a demo that impresses and a system that ships
  • You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure scalable and maintainable, and you are comfortable defending that view with technical depth and real-world examples
  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially when integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into established silicon development environments where stability and correctness are non-negotiable
  • You think in systems, understanding how changes in one part of the CAD flow ripple through design, verification, and downstream lifecycle analytics
  • You do not need perfect documentation or fully baked requirements to get started, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and find a path forward

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of the Silicon Lifecycle Management IP Development team in Bangalore, working at the intersection of advanced IP design and AI-driven automation. This team is responsible for building the infrastructure and workflows that power SLM IP development across Synopsys, and you will be the principal engineer defining how agentic AI gets integrated into that foundation. You will collaborate closely with IP designers, CAD engineers, and Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform teams, bridging technical domains and driving alignment across a distributed, highly technical organization. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibilities across multiple globally distributed engineering teams. This role may evolve into leading a small team of AI infrastructure engineers as adoption scales.


Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  • Understanding of Python for network automation, API integration, validation, configuration generation, telemetry processing and operational tooling.

Required Experience & Qualifications
  • 16+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience with significant L4 responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience as Principal Network Engineer, L4 Engineer, Network Architect, Network Solution Engineer or equivalent.
  • CCNP Enterprise / CCNP Security or equivalent advanced Cisco expertise required; CCIE strongly preferred.
  • Proven technical-team leadership experience.

Required Skills

AWS Advanced Networking Specialty Network Security SD-WAN ZERO Trust Network Operations Cisco Unified Communications Manager CCIE CCNP Cisco Enterprise Networking Palo Alto PCNSE

jobDescription:
Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 12 - 17 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions underpinned by the world s largest delivery network Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

About Digital Core Reinvention Partner:

Digital Core Reinvention Partner helps clients reinvent their digital foundations including technology strategy and architecture, AI and data, modernizing and managing applications, infrastructure, and cloud. We operate in lockstep with our Reinvention Engines especially Technology and AI and Data. In practice, Digital Core brings the integrated client solution and team together, while the Engines continuously strengthen the skills, tools, methods, and AI-enabled delivery that those teams use. And Client Success will ensure our solutions are commercially strong, repeatable, and aligned to what clients truly need bringing the full strength of Accenture to every engagement. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Digital Core Reinvention Partner s services include those provided by our Global Network a distributed organization that provides advisory and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world.

For more information visit Welcome to Digital Core | Digital Core

At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team




Qualification

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Bachelor''s degree (relevant discipline); Master''s / MBA strongly preferred.
  • PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.
  • SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.

Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) advantageous

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Salesforce Agentforce Engineer, you will design, build, and configure intelligent agent-based solutions using Agentforce and Agentforce Vibes. You will contribute as a senior developer, supporting the development and deployment of Salesforce agents aligned with business requirements.

Design, configure, and implement Salesforce agents using Agentforce and Agentforce Vibes.
Build agent workflows, prompts, and orchestration logic.
Develop supporting Salesforce components using Apex, LWC, and Flows.
Collaborate with functional teams to understand agent use cases.
Integrate Agentforce with Salesforce data and external systems.
Participate in technical discussions and solution design activities.
Follow Agentforce implementation standards and best practices.
Assist in testing, deployment, and validation of agent solutions.
Support defect resolution and optimization activities.
Document agent configurations and technical flows.
Continuously learn new Agentforce features and AI capabilities.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must Have Skills
Strong Salesforce development skills.
Hands-on experience with:
oApex
oLightning Web Components (LWC)
oSalesforce Flows
Basic hands-on exposure to:
oAgentforce
oAgentforce Vibes
Understanding of conversational AI fundamentals.
Experience with Salesforce APIs and integration techniques.
Knowledge of Salesforce security, sharing model, and governor limits.
Ability to develop maintainable and scalable solutions.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Certifications Required
Salesforce Platform Developer I - Mandatory
Salesforce Administrator - Preferred
Agentforce Specialist - Preferred or In Progress
Salesforce AI Associate - Preferred

Additional Information:
3-5 years of Salesforce experience.
Exposure to Agentforce implementation projects is preferred.
Experience working in Agile teams.
15 years of full-time education is required.

Qualification 15 years full time education

  • Lead large-scale Technology M&A programs across mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, and joint ventures.

  • Lead sign-to-close planning, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, separation planning, TSA strategy, and TSA exit execution.

  • Oversee Integration Management Office (IMO) and Separation Management Office (SMO) governance, execution, and value realization activities.

  • Define technology integration and separation strategies across applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, ERP, and operating models.

  • Drive synergy identification, value capture, risk mitigation, and transaction execution planning.

  • Lead multi-disciplinary consulting teams and provide overall engagement leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder management.

  • Build executive-level business cases, steering committee materials, and transformation roadmaps.

  • Support business development, proposal creation, thought leadership, and practice growth initiatives.

  • Develop and mentor managers and consultants within the Technology M&A practice.


Bring Your Best Skills Forward



  • Deep experience leading Technology M&A engagements including integrations, separations, carve-outs, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post-merger integration programs.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to manage large, complex, global programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting sales, account growth, and client relationship development.

  • Ability to translate transaction objectives into actionable technology strategies and execution plans.

  1. IT Infrastructure & Cloud



  • Infrastructure integration and separation planning.

  • Cloud migration and cloud operating model considerations.

  • Data center, network, workplace, hosting, and end-user computing environments.

  • Infrastructure TSA planning and exit execution.



  1. ERP



  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP platforms.

  • ERP integration, harmonization, migration, or carve-out activities.

  • Understanding of business process impacts, reporting, controls, and data migration considerations during transactions.



  1. Enterprise Architecture & IT Operating Model Transformation



  • Enterprise architecture assessments and target-state design.

  • Application portfolio rationalization and technology roadmap development.

  • IT operating model design and transformation.

  • Technology governance, capability models, and organizational design considerations during integrations and separations.

They should be comfortable advising clients on transaction implications, identifying risks and dependencies, and shaping integration and separation strategies across the deal lifecycle.

Roles Responsibilities:

  • Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery using Generative and Agentic AI to solve complex business problems, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise operations for measurable impact.

  • Architect and implement Generative AI pipelines on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine + Knowledge Graph Engine).
  • Design and manage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG workflows to improve the grounding, accuracy, and interpretability of LLM outputs.
  • Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs) with enterprise data sources through grounding modules, vector similarity search, and semantic search.
  • Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications.
  • Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing.
  • Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats.
  • Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications.
  • Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments.
  • Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization.
  • Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision.
  • Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projectsfrom model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope.
  • Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures.
  • Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks.
  • Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives.

    Professional Technical Skills:Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine).
  • Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search.
  • Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases.
  • Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization.
  • Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps.
  • Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions.
  • Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems.
  • Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies.
  • Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization.
  • Ability to analyze and optimize application performance.

    Additional Information:
  • Sr. Manager:16+ years of experience as solution architect driving SAP BTP Gen AI initiatives.
  • Completed minimum of 15 years of full-time education with Bachelors or Masters (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA) in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics Communication from a recognized institution.
  • Experience in Agentic development with A2A protocol with MCP server.
  • Working knowledge of RDF, SPARQL, OWL or equivalent graph technologies.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or SAP Continuous Integration Delivery).
  • Knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and tracing AI requests through pipelines.
  • Experience deploying AI workloads with Terraform / BTP CLI / Kyma Runtime automation.
  • Awareness of Responsible AI principles:transparency, explainability, fairness, and privacy.
    Qualification15 years full time education

Our customers include many of the worlds largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies dont, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can t do it exceptionally well, we don t do it. It s how weve assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it s how we re reinventing what s possible every day.

This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.

Plume is looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build and run a product/feature team that owns the heart of our connectivity product: Wi-Fi optimization, standards-based device management over TR-369 (USP) and TR-181, device provisioning and lifecycle, and the cloud-based controller that orchestrates all of it across WAN and LAN. You will own the roadmap, the architecture and the people for a team of 10-20 engineers spanning embedded, cloud and networking disciplines and you will still be close enough to the code to review a design, debug a customer escalation, and make the hard technical call yourself. Your teams software runs on tens of millions of live gateways and access points at some of the worlds largest ISPs, so the decisions you make are felt at real scale, by real subscribers, immediately.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with Product Management, cloud and firmware teams across three continents, and directly with ISP customers. If you want the ownership of a founding team leader with the leverage of an established platform, this is that role.

What Youll Do:

Lead the team

  • Build, lead and grow a team of 8-12 engineers in Hyderabad - hire, onboard, coach, run 1:1s, set expectations and own performance and career development
  • Establish the engineering culture for a growing site: high standards on design review, code quality, testing and on-call discipline
  • Grow senior engineers into technical leaders and create clear paths for the people who dont want to manage
  • Partner with recruiting to raise the bar on hiring, and represent Plume credibly to strong candidates

Own the outcome

  • Own end-to-end delivery for your feature area: planning, prioritisation, execution, quality and operational health in production
  • Translate product strategy with Product Management into a technical roadmap, then hold the team to it - including the trade-offs about what not to build
  • Drive cross-team execution with cloud, firmware, data and QA groups across multiple time zones
  • Represent your area in escalations and in front of ISP customers; understand their problems and get them surgically solved

Stay Technical

  • Set architectural direction for Wi-Fi optimization, device provisioning and lifecycle management, the cloud controller, and WAN/LAN feature delivery
  • Lead design reviews, write and review code where it matters most, and remain the person who can go deep on a hard bug
  • Own the TR-369 (USP) and TR-181 data model strategy - how the platform is modelled, versioned and evolved across a multi-vendor device fleet
  • Drive scale, latency and reliability decisions for a system managing tens of millions of devices
  • Represent Plume in external forums such as the Broadband Forum, RDK-B, prpl Foundation and the Wi-Fi Alliance

What Youll Bring:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years directly managing or formally leading engineering teams
  • A track record of shipping production software in networking, connectivity, broadband CPE or a closely adjacent domain
  • Deep, current hands-on strength in at least one of C/C++, Java, Go or Python, and the ability to be technically credible across the rest of the stack
  • Strong command of computer networking: L2/L3/L4, routing, switching, NAT, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, WAN and LAN architectures, and IEEE 802.11
  • Working knowledge of standards-based device management - TR-369 (USP), TR-181, TR-069 - and what it takes to operate a data model across a heterogeneous device fleet
  • Experience with device provisioning, zero-touch onboarding, firmware/OTA update flows and device lifecycle at scale
  • Experience with cloud-based control planes: distributed systems, microservices, event streaming, stateful services, and the operational reality of running them
  • Demonstrated ability to grow engineers, give direct feedback well, and manage performance honestly
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable being the technical voice in front of a customer or an executive
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Wi-Fi optimization or RRM - channel and band steering, mesh topology optimization, client steering, airtime fairness
  • Hands-on work with OpenSync, RDK-B, prplOS, OpenWRT, hostapd/wpa_supplicant or EasyMesh (R2/R3)
  • Wi-Fi 6E / Wi-Fi 7 features such as MLO, OFDMA and MU-MIMO
  • Applied ML or data-driven optimization in a networking product
  • Experience working directly with ISPs or telecom operators as a customer
  • Prior experience standing up or scaling an engineering site or a new team
  • Contributions to open-source connectivity projects or standards bodies

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world s largest such as Comcast, Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

As a Principal Software Engineer , you will play a critical role in architecture design, developing, and maintaining high-quality software applications using C# and React. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features while ensuring the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications. This position requires a deep understanding of software engineering principles and a passion for developing scalable and efficient software solutions.

What You ll Do

  • Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of applications using .NET Core, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.
  • System Design: Design and implement robust, scalable, and maintainable software systems, including both front-end and back-end components.
  • Continuous Improvement: Advocate for best practices in software development, including code quality, testing, and deployment processes. Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Research & Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending improvements and new technologies to enhance product offerings.
  • Problem Solving: Analyse and troubleshoot complex software issues, providing timely resolutions and ensuring minimal impact on the user experience.
  • AI Capabilities: Design and implement AI enabled features and services such as agentic workflows, automation, search, or chat assistants. Integrate AI/ML services and models into backend services via APIs using secure and scalable patterns-enabled features and services
  • Team Management: Mentor and guide a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Project Coordination: Collaborate with product managers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You ll Bring

  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 12+ years of experience in software development with a strong focus on .NET core, C#, WEB API, MS SQL, react, LLMs, Elastic Search
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
  • Experience with database technologies, both SQL (e.g., SQL Server) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Proven experience in AI based Productivity tools : code conversion/refactoring, test generation with coverage thresholds, defect clustering, changelog summarization, architectural blueprints.
  • Proven experience in product-based companies, delivering scalable and customer-centric solutions.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, including knowledge of data modelling, querying, and performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools (e.g., Scrum, Jira).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Tech Stack:

  • Back-end: C#, .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Core 7+, Python, NodeJS
  • Frontend: React or Angular
  • Data: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL; MongoDB; Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
  • Cloud/Infra: AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, SQS/Event Bridge, RDS, MongoDB), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, GitHub Actions/Jenkins
  • AI: LLM, MCP, RAG, AI Agents

About TylSemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

- Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.

- Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.

- IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.


Culture & Team: How We Work No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.

- No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

- India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

Were not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. Were building to win.

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. Youre not here to execute someone elses roadmap. Youre here to define it.

- Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesnt fly here.

- Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people whove shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.

- Low ego, high standards. We dont care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask

If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

Were asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Heres why you should:

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what were building.

- The team has done this before. Weve built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isnt our first rodeo.

- The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.

- The work is consequential. Youre not optimizing someones ad click-through rate. Youre building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

READY TO JOIN

About the role

TylSemi is looking for a Program Management and Execution Leader who can sit at the intersection of SoC execution, silicon realization, and customer success. You will own the operational thread that connects our stretagic initiatives to customers and SoC execution - making sure every engagement moves with precision from idea to silicon.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at a company in its earliest and most consequential stage. You will work directly with founders, customers, the leading semiconductor ecosystem players. No layers, no ambiguity about impact.

What youll do

  • Manage all active customer engagements end-to-end: from architectural spec alignment through tape-out, KGD testing, packaging, and volume shipment milestones
  • Ensure alignment with ecosystem partners - including foundries, OSAT/packaging houses, EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence), and IP partners
  • Translate customer requirements (silicon architecture, interface specs, package form factor, delivery schedules) into internal program plans with clear owners and dates
  • Build and maintain program trackers, risk registers, and executive dashboards covering each engagement
  • Drive gate reviews and weekly program syncs across internal RTL/DV, physical design, and validation teams
  • Manage internal and external scoping and delivery timelines in coordination with technical and business teams
  • Identify and escalate risks early; propose and implement mitigations before they become schedule threats

What you bring

  • 15+ years of technical program or project management experience in semiconductor, custom silicon, or chiplet/advanced packaging environments
  • Direct experience interfacing with ecosystem partners - chip development schedules, interdepencies on EDA and IP, tape-out schedules and silicon bringup timelines
  • Familiarity with silicon fabrication, advanced packaging formats: CoWoS, InFO, 2.5D/3D integration, substrate/interposer-based assembly
  • Technical fluency in SoC or chiplet design flows - enough to understand RTL milestones, DV sign-off, PD handoffs, and silicon bring-up phases without needing translation
  • Strong communication skills - comfortable presenting program status and risk posture to internal and external stakeholders
  • Proficiency with program tracking tools (and spreadsheet-based trackers); experience building program infrastructure from scratch is a plus
  • Familiarity with key connectivity IPs UCIe, PCIe Gen 5/6/7+, or high-bandwidth D2D interconnect standards is a strong plus

Nice to Have to Shine

  • Prior experience at a chiplet startup, merchant silicon company, or systems company
  • Background in AI/ML infrastructure silicon - accelerators, network switches, CPO-enabled platforms
  • Familiarity with IVR/PMIC integration challenges in advanced packaging
  • Exposure to EDA infrastructure programs (SNPS/CDNS cloud flows)

Job Summary

At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

As a Principal DevOps Engineer on our Engineering Services team, you will design, deliver, and operate the CI/CD and automation infrastructure that underpins Gigamon's embedded software products. You will lead the evolution of our continuous integration framework, partnering closely with cross-functional engineering teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable, robust solutions. In this senior role, you will act as a key technical authority for critical engineering tools and workflows, ensuring reliability, performance, and adherence to best practices. You will work autonomously to drive improvements in productivity, quality, and release velocity across multiple, overlapping product lines.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain CI pipelines using Jenkins, Gerrit, and GitLab for build and test automation of embedded software products.
  • Champion best practices for CI/CD, SDLC workflows, and quality gates across engineering teams.
  • Explore, evaluate, and implement new toolsets and optimizations to improve developer productivity and quality control.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and subject-matter expert for key engineering tools, including Gerrit, GitLab, Coverity, JIRA, TestRail, Black Duck, and Artifactory.
  • Administer Linux systems and applications, including patching, upgrading, and modifying configurations to meet evolving business and security requirements.
  • Provide frontline support for CI-related issues, triaging and resolving problems with the CI environment and production build infrastructure.
  • Manage the release and distribution of build artifacts to customer download portals, following strict change control processes and security best practices.
  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for CI/CD pipelines, tools, and infrastructure, and actively share knowledge and best practices across the team.
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based operations, including occasional weekend work and adjusted work hours as needed to support global teams.
  • (Nice to have) Administer and scale Jenkins environments, including patching and performance tuning.
  • (Nice to have) Contribute to code signing workflows and PKI infrastructure to support secure delivery.
  • (Nice to have) Partner with QA and test teams to integrate test automation and execution into CI/CD pipelines.

What you've done

  • Earned a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) and have 13+ years of hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and applications, including Linux administration.
  • Built and maintained complex Jenkins pipelines, with deep expertise in scripted pipelines and pipeline-as-code concepts.
  • Gained 10+ years of scripting experience in languages such as Python, Perl, or Groovy, and applied this expertise to automation, tooling, and infrastructure.
  • Developed expert-level proficiency with Git/GitLab and source control best practices, including branching strategies, code review workflows, and change management policies.
  • Implemented and supported continuous integration and software frameworks for pre- and post-commit gates in multi-tier application environments.
  • Administered and integrated tools such as JIRA, Coverity, Artifactory, Black Duck, and TestRail within a CI/CD ecosystem.
  • Supported rapid, overlapping product release cycles, ensuring reliable, repeatable builds and releases in a high-velocity engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document systems and processes clearly and collaborate effectively with diverse technical teams.

Who you are

  • A hands-on technical leader who can operate autonomously, take ownership of complex problems, and drive solutions that align with department and organizational goals.
  • Calm and effective under pressure, with a strong sense of accountability for production CI/CD environments and release quality.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a disciplined approach to change control, security, and documentation.
  • A proactive collaborator who builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and serves as a trusted advisor on CI/CD and tooling.
  • Curious and improvement-focused, continually seeking opportunities to enhance tools, workflows, and automation to better support engineers and customers.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title : AVP - DC Automation
Company : BDx India Pvt Ltd
Department : IT
Position Reporting to : Innovation Head
Location : India

ROLE SUMMARY
The Assistant Vice President of Data Center Automation is a senior leadership role responsible for driving the automation, optimization, and security of data center operations. This position oversees Building Management System (BMS) operations, and OSS/BSS (Operational Support Systems/Business Support Systems) functions, ensuring seamless integration, efficiency, and resilience across all systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, strategic vision, and proven experience in managing large-scale data center and telecom/IT service environments.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Technical Scope of Work
1. System Architecture Design - Must
  • Define and document the overall control architecture , including:
    • PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
    • OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
    • Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
  • Develop IO lists , control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS) .
  • Coordinate between MEP consultants , controls contractors , and operations to align automation design.
2. Control System Development - Must
  • Author control sequence logic for:
    • Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
    • Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
  • Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
  • Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
  • Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC-UA , and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation.
3. Commissioning Validation - Must
  • Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
  • Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
  • Oversee integration testing with DCIM , AIops , or energy optimization platforms.
4. OT Cybersecurity Governance - Great to Have
  • Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
    • Network segregation between IT and OT.
    • Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
    • Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
  • Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
  • Maintain system access logs , firmware inventories, and security posture reports.
5. Operations Enablement - Must
  • Create OM procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
    • Change management and version control.
    • Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
    • Data historian configuration and retention policies.
  • Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
6. Continuous Optimization - Must
  • Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
    • Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
    • Integrate AI models for predictive control.
    • Support digital twin deployment and data validation.
Deliverables
  • Control Philosophy Document (CPD)
  • Functional Design Specification (FDS)
  • Control System Architecture Network Diagram
  • FAT/SAT Test Protocols Reports
  • OT Security Policy for Automation Systems
  • Standardized Tag List Alarm Database
QUALIFICATION EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience, Mechanical, Electrical or Controls degree preferred.
- Excellent understanding of industry-standard electrical and mechanical systems used in data centers, as well as controls/monitoring systems.
- Experience of 15 + years in designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, Building Management System (BMS) Controls software and networks.
- Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
- Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
- Project coordination experience with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements for data centers.
- TCP/IP, MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS communication protocol experience.
- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.

Change Management Adoption

  • Guide enterprise AI adoption and organizational transformation.
  • Support implementation, rollout and adoption of AI-driven business processes.

  • Mentor architects and engineers while driving technical excellence and innovation.

Experience

  • Consultative Mindset
  • Strong client-facing consulting and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into practical AI solutions and articulate measurable ROI.
  • Solution Architecture
  • Experience producing enterprise architectures, technical proposals and implementation roadmaps.

  • Client Engagement
  • Experience in discovery workshops, AI readiness assessments, technical consulting, pre-sales, solution presentations, proposal development and executive stakeholder engagement.

Technical Expertise Required

Traditional AI Machine Learning

  • Strong expertise in Computer Vision, NLP, Predictive Analytics, Recommendation Systems or related AI domains, including production ML pipelines, evaluation methodologies and MLOps.

  • Hands-on experience with core Python, enterprise GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, LLM orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent), evaluation frameworks, AI observability, guardrails and production monitoring.

Software Engineering

  • Expertise in Git, CI/CD, automated testing, API development, microservices, design patterns, secure coding and Agile development.
  • Cloud Platform Engineering
  • Experience deploying enterprise AI on Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker and Vertex AI using Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and cloud-native deployment practices.

Enterprise Systems

  • Experience integrating AI with CRM, ERP, eCommerce and enterprise platforms using modern APIs and distributed architectures.
  • Governance Security
  • Strong understanding of Responsible AI, explainability, model governance, AI risk management, data lineage, enterprise security, GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2 and AI regulatory frameworks, including protection against prompt injection and data leakage.

  • Experience establishing enterprise AI standards, reusable frameworks and AI practice governance.
  • Expertise in AI observability, automated evaluation, benchmarking, guardrails and production monitoring.
  • Familiarity with MCP, A2A and advanced agent orchestration.
  • Experience optimizing AI platforms for scalability, latency and cost.

Our R&D division is growing globally, and we are looking for an experienced Technical Lead Embedded Control Firmware to join our dynamic team at the new R&D site in Bangalore, India.
As a Technical Lead Embedded Control Firmware , you will be a crucial member of the SolarEdge India R&D team, responsible for developing embedded control firmware for our advanced solar energy products. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and testing embedded control firmware, ensuring its reliability, performance, and seamless integration with our hardware platforms.

  • Lead, design and development of embedded control firmware for SolarEdges solar power conversion products, including inverters, power optimizers, and energy storage converter.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, embedded developers, and product/project managers, to define system requirements, design concepts/ideas and agreed with innovative architect embedded solutions.
  • Develop and implement efficient and reliable embedded digital control firmware in C/C++ for various microcontrollers and processors used in SolarEdge products.
  • Conduct thorough testing and verification of embedded control firmware to ensure its functionality, performance, and compliance with quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot and debug embedded control firmware and hardware interactions, identifying and resolving issues throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in embedded systems to propose and integrate cutting-edge technologies into SolarEdges products.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and validation teams to support the production and testing of embedded control firmware during the manufacturing process.
  • Support the certification process by providing necessary documentation and technical inputs to comply with relevant safety and regulatory standards.

  • Bachelors (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with 14+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )
  • Master s degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Power Electronics/Control System/Embedded System Engineering with 12+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )
  • Ph.D. in Closed loop control firmware design and development for Power converter/Inverter/DC-DC Converter with 10+years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development.
  • Design and Implementation of embedded digital control algorithms in C/C++ for power converter, such as DC/AC Inverters and DC/DC converters operating at high switching frequency.
  • Strong knowledge and proven experience in developing control algorithms for Power electronics converters/Inverters.
  • Experience in optimizing firmware algorithms to enhance system efficiency and reliability .
  • Experience in Control loop Simulation and Software-in-the-loop (SIL) using PLECS/MATLAB tools.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the Loop (HIL) using Typhoon HIL /MATLAB is desirable.
  • Experience in Real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal code development.
  • Strong understanding of microcontrollers / microprocessors and it s peripherals , and embedded system architectures.
  • Hands on embedded control firmware experience using MCU s such as TI/ST/Renesas etc.
  • Working knowledge on the protocols and devices driver for SPI, I2C, UART, CAN.
  • Ability to identify, troubleshoot firmware / hardware technical problems.
  • Experience developing device drivers and execute a tight interrupt loop in bare metal implementation.
  • Working knowledge in using JTAG/SWD debugger.
  • Experience in board bring-up, peripheral integration, and device driver development.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a track record of delivering robust and reliable embedded software.
  • Knowledge of software development tools, version control systems, and debugging tools for embedded systems.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in the renewable energy or power electronics industry is an added advantage.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance during product development. Stay up to date with the latest advancements in power electronics and firmware technologies.
  • Drive results within constraints of Product life cycle development and production at scale.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving tangible and measurable results.
SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
Digital Platforms (App & Web) are the key drivers of companys growth strategy and are expected to generate over 30% of the companys business over the next 3 years. These platforms generate over 2Bn sessions, 100 Mn App download and 100Mn monthly active users (MAU) annually generating traffic for over 73+ P&Ls of the company.
This is a strategic position and critical to the companys success as an omnipresent financial services company, across shopping, loans, wheels, trading, insurance, investments and payments.
This position will be responsible for supporting the business for the companys across portfolios along with the business teams to create a winning content strategy. The strategy is built for scale and efficiency leveraging technologies and AI stack
We are seeking a visionary and experienced leader to oversee our content strategy, traffic generation, technical SEO, podcasts, prompt engineering, and project management. This multifaceted role demands a leader with a deep understanding of content marketing, digital strategy, e-commerce dynamics, AI, NLP, and project management. The ideal candidate will drive initiatives that enhance brand engagement, support business growth, optimize technical infrastructure, and provide exceptional customer experiences across all digital touchpoints.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Planning & Execution
  • Dominate discovery App, Web & Social
  • Customer experience & retention
  • Projects such as Podcasts
  • Pioneering AI for scale and efficiency
  • Data and consumer insights
  • Project management
  • Team management
  • Leadership
  • Partner & stakeholders management
  • Dominate organic discovery App, Web & Social
  • Collaborate with Traffic Head, App Acquisition Head and Social head to architect and implement a cutting-edge discovery strategy to achieve and maintain top search engine rankings for high-intent keywords across all business categories
  • Create a core content blueprint to drive web traffic. Develop high-quality, user-focused content designed to secure top rankings for key queries.
  • Optimize app store listings with compelling, keyword-rich copy and strategic messaging for screenshots and videos to boost visibility and conversions.
  • Drive social engagement by creating a pipeline of versatile content assets (videos, infographics, carousels, articles) that are optimized for sharing and discussion to increase brand reach and referral traffic.
  • Produce authoritative, industry-leading content (e.g., original research, data studies, comprehensive guides) to serve as a foundation for link-building and digital PR, enhancing our domain authority.
  • Ensure a cohesive keyword and topic strategy across all platforms. Translate technical insights from SEO and ASO teams into a concrete content production plan that systematically targets opportunities.
  • Lead the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) into the content workflow to drive scale, efficiency, and innovation.
  • Develop and master prompt engineering techniques to leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) for content ideation, creation, summarization, and optimization.
  • Evaluate and deploy AI-powered tools for SEO analysis, content personalization, predictive analytics, and competitor intelligence.
  • Establish best practices and ethical guidelines for the use of AI in content creation to ensure quality, accuracy, and brand compliance.
  • Collaborate with Technology and Product teams to build, drive and implement AI led initiatives such as Content production, Podcasts and alike
  • Champion the creation of user-centric content that simplifies complex financial topics, answers customer questions, and guides them seamlessly through their journey.
  • Utilize data to map content to different stages of the user lifecycle (awareness, consideration, conversion, loyalty) to enhance engagement and reduce churn.
  • Implement content personalization strategies on the app and web to deliver relevant and timely information, enhancing user satisfaction and retention.
  • Develop and manage content for retention channels, including newsletters, push notifications, and in-app messaging, to foster long-term customer relationships.
  • Establish a robust analytics and reporting framework to measure content performance, tying key metrics like organic traffic, engagement, and conversion back to business revenue.
  • Utilize web/app analytics, tools and market research to derive actionable consumer insights that inform content strategy and identify new opportunities.
  • Conduct regular content audits and gap analyses to ensure our content portfolio remains relevant, competitive, and comprehensive.
  • Present data-driven insights and performance reports to senior leadership and business stakeholders to demonstrate the ROI of content marketing.
  • Develop and own the comprehensive, multi-channel content strategy, ensuring tight alignment with the company''s overall business objectives and the specific goals of 73+ P&Ls.
  • Create and manage a master content calendar and production roadmap, encompassing web, app, social media, and new media formats to ensure a consistent and impactful brand voice.
  • Establish and govern content workflows, from ideation and creation to publishing, distribution, and performance analysis.
  • Define the budget for content operations, including team, tools, and external agencies, ensuring optimal allocation of resources for maximum ROI.
  • Translate high-level business goals into actionable content marketing plans, campaigns, and projects.
  • Employ Agile or similar project management methodologies to manage a high volume of content projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for all major content initiatives, defining project scope, timelines, resource allocation, and deliverables.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks and dependencies that could impact project timelines or quality.
  • Utilize project management tools to track progress, facilitate collaboration, and maintain transparency with all stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary thought leader for content within the organization, articulating a clear and compelling vision for the future of our content ecosystem.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, algorithm updates, and emerging technologies, and translate them into strategic advantages for the company.
  • Champion a "content-first" mindset across the organization, influencing product, marketing, and technology roadmaps.
  • Lead and mentor a high-performing team of content strategists, SEO specialists, writers, editors, and new media producers.
  • Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the content team.
  • Set clear goals and KPIs for the team and individuals, conducting regular performance reviews and providing constructive feedback for professional development.
  • Empower the team with the necessary tools, resources, and training to succeed in their roles.
  • Partner & Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, including business heads, product managers, marketing leads, and the technology team, to ensure alignment and drive shared success.
  • Manage relationships with external partners, including content agencies, freelancers, technology vendors, and influencers, ensuring they deliver high-quality work that meets our standards.
  • Effectively communicate content strategy, plans, and results to executive leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures and negotiate priorities to ensure content initiatives receive the necessary support and resources.
Required Qualifications and Experience
a) Qualifications:
  • Bachelors degree in communications, Marketing, Finance, or a related field; Masters degree preferred.
  • Content Creation and Management, previous experience in digital platforms, digital content, or EdTech is a significant plus.
  • AI

Job Summary

You will join an applied AI team building computer vision and generative AI solutions. Based on project needs and your strengths, you will work primarily in either computer vision or GenAI/RAG, with structured exposure to adjacent workflows. Senior engineers will provide architecture guidance, code review and support as you grow your delivery ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare, validate, and version datasets, experiment configurations, and evaluation results.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models using PyTorch or TensorFlow under senior guidance; maintain reproducible experiment logs.
  • Implement computer vision components such as classification, detection, segmentation, or video-processing pipelines; or build GenAI components such as prompting, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.
  • Contribute across the applied AI stack data preparation, model experimentation, APIs, application integration, deployment, and monitoring rather than working only on model code.
  • Create proof-of-concepts to validate new models, workflows, and product ideas before wider implementation.
  • Contribute reusable code, experiment findings, internal demos, and technical documentation to the internal AI Lab.
  • Integrate AI components with REST APIs, vector retrieval systems, and basic tool-calling workflows.
  • Write clean, testable, and documented Python; contribute through Git-based reviews and follow team engineering standards.
  • Investigate model and integration defects, compare evaluation results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Collaborate with data, backend, product, and senior AI engineers to deliver scoped features from development through validation.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of relevant software, data, or ML experience, or equivalent evidence through substantial academic or personal projects.
  • Strong Python fundamentals, including data structures, modular code, debugging, and basic automated testing.
  • Clear understanding of core software and ML concepts, including APIs, the data/model lifecycle, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and inference.
  • An open, technology-agnostic mindset, with willingness to learn and select tools based on the problem rather than preference for a particular framework.
  • Working knowledge of at least one applied AI area: computer vision, GenAI/RAG, or agent/tool-calling workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one deep-learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, Linux fundamentals, and Docker basics.
  • Ability to evaluate results using appropriate metrics and explain the trade-offs or limitations you observe.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, a learning mindset, and comfort asking for help early.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to OpenCV, YOLO, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable libraries.
  • Experience with vector search using FAISS, Qdrant, Pinecone, or an equivalent technology.
  • Basic cloud or GPU-compute experience on AWS, GCP, Azure, or an on-premises environment.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, experiment tracking, or model-serving concepts.
  • A portfolio, Kaggle work, research project, or deployed application demonstrating practical AI problem-solving.

Autonomy and Collaboration

You will execute well-defined tasks with regular check-ins, raise blockers early, and escalate architecture, security, and production-impacting decisions. As your judgment develops, you will take ownership of larger components and contribute more actively to technical planning.

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect lifes other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager who can act as a strong leader and provide guidance to multiple squads of Software Development Engineers. Our Manager will have a passion for building complex web and enterprise applications. As the leader of the squads, you will be creating clear objectives and deliverables with an emphasis on scalability, maintainability, security, and performance.
